data.description: Po raz pierwszy nie wysyłalibyśmy gremialnie ludzi do banków [po kredyt hipoteczny] tylko dalibyśmy im „znaczone” pieniądze, które mogliby przeznaczyć na wkład własny przy kupnie mieszkania, albo na remont nieruchomości, albo na materiały budowlane w markecie. Rozmowa z Bartoszem Marczukiem, wiceministrem rodziny, pracy i polityki społecznej w rządach PiS.
data.translatedTitle: Bartosz Marczuk: Let's grant a housing voucher of PLN 100,000. PLN for the birth of a child
data.translatedDescription: For the first time, we would not send people en masse to banks [for a mortgage loan], but we would give them "significant" money that they could use for their own contribution when buying an apartment, or for renovating the property, or for building materials in the supermarket. Interview with Bartosz Marczuk, deputy minister of family, labor and social policy in the PiS government.

data.title: Mają nowy sposób na obejście zakazu handlu w niedzielę. Posłanka chce zmian
data.description: Rolniczy handel detaliczny może być wykorzystywany jako kolejny sposób na ominięcie zakazu handlu w niedzielę – donosi portal DlaHandlu.pl. W związku z tym posłanka Wioletta Kulpa domaga się sprawdzenia skali zjawiska i uszczelnienia przepisów. Wcześniej niektóre markety próbowały obejść zakaz poprzez prowadzenie klubów czytelnika w sklepie, jednak zasadność korzystania z tego wyjątku zakwestionował Sąd Najwyższy.
data.translatedTitle: They have a new way to circumvent the Sunday trading ban. The MP wants changes
data.translatedDescription: Agricultural retail trade can be used as another way to circumvent the Sunday trading ban - reports DlaHandlu.pl. Therefore, MP Wioletta Kulpa demands that the scale of the phenomenon be checked and that the regulations be tightened. Previously, some supermarkets tried to circumvent the ban by running reader's clubs in the store, but the validity of using this exception was questioned by the Supreme Court.

data.title: Nie wytrzymał azjatyckiej konkurencji. Niemiecki producent plecaków zbankrutował
data.description: Red Rebane, znany niemiecki producent plecaków i toreb rowerowych oznaczonych charakterystycznym logo z czerwonym lisem, ogłosił upadłość. Firma przegrała z rosnącymi kosztami oraz tańszymi produktami z Azji. Okazuje się jednak, że marka nie zniknie całkowicie z rynku.
data.translatedTitle: It couldn't withstand the Asian competition. The German backpack manufacturer went bankrupt
data.translatedDescription: Red Rebane, a well-known German manufacturer of backpacks and bicycle bags marked with a characteristic red fox logo, announced bankruptcy. The company lost out to rising costs and cheaper products from Asia. However, it turns out that the brand will not completely disappear from the market.

data.title: Polacy „bardziej świadomi i selektywni”. Eksperci o pracy sezonowej za granicą
data.description: Zarobki Polki, która przez 33 dni zbierała truskawki w Niemczech, wywołały niedawno dyskusję wśród polskich internautów. Pod relacją kobiety zamieszczoną na TikToku pojawiło się mnóstwo skrajnych komentarzy. Teraz do sprawy pracy za granicą odnieśli się w rozmowie z serwisem PulsHR eksperci.
data.translatedTitle: Poles "more aware and selective". Experts on seasonal work abroad
data.translatedDescription: The earnings of a Polish woman who picked strawberries in Germany for 33 days have recently sparked a discussion among Polish Internet users. There were a lot of extreme comments under the woman's account posted on TikTok. Now experts commented on the issue of working abroad in an interview with PulsHR.

data.title: Spór o inspektorów przewodnika Michelin. Branża gastro zadaje niewygodne pytanie
data.description: Słynny gastronomiczny przewodnik Michelin świetnie się rozwija. Rośnie liczba ocenianych restauracji, a także grono krajów, które obejmują kolejne edycje. Wydawca pilnuje informacji o tym, kim są inspektorzy próbujący dań w restauracjach, a także – ilu ich jest. Coraz częściej słychać jednak pytania o to, czy jest ich wystarczająca liczba i są w stanie właściwie ocenić badane lokale.
data.translatedTitle: Dispute over Michelin Guide inspectors. The gastro industry is asking an uncomfortable question
data.translatedDescription: The famous Michelin gastronomic guide is thriving. The number of rated restaurants is growing, as is the number of countries included in subsequent editions. The publisher keeps track of information about who the inspectors who try dishes in restaurants are, as well as how many of them there are. However, questions are increasingly being raised about whether there are enough of them and whether they are able to properly assess the premises being examined.

data.title: Naukowcy u progu stworzenia cyfrowego bliźniaka ludzkiego mózgu. Wymieniają korzyści
data.description: Czego potrzeba do stworzenia elektronicznej kopii ludzkiego mózgu? Odpowiedzi na to pytanie szukali naukowcy z Uniwersytetu Warwick. Okazało się, że niezbędne jest m.in. dokładne poznanie żywego narządu.
data.translatedTitle: Scientists are on the verge of creating a digital twin of the human brain. They list the benefits
data.translatedDescription: What does it take to create an electronic copy of a human brain? Scientists from the University of Warwick were looking for the answer to this question. It turned out that it is necessary, among others, detailed knowledge of a living organ.

data.title: Eksperci mają dobre wiadomości o e-papierosach. Stawiają dwa warunki
data.description: Grupa ekspertów zajmujących się uzależnieniem od nikotyny opublikowała zalecenia dla lekarzy dotyczące tego, jak rozmawiać z palaczami o e-papierosach. Ich zdaniem przejście dorosłego palacza całkowicie na e-papierosy jest prawdopodobnie znacznie mniej szkodliwe niż dalsze palenie zwykłych papierosów. Choć wciąż lepiej w ogóle nie używać nikotyny.
data.translatedTitle: Experts have good news about e-cigarettes. They set two conditions
data.translatedDescription: A group of experts dealing with nicotine addiction has published recommendations for doctors on how to talk to smokers about e-cigarettes. In their opinion, switching an adult smoker entirely to e-cigarettes is probably much less harmful than continuing to smoke regular cigarettes. Although it's still better not to use nicotine at all.

data.title: Wysokie koszty życia przytłaczają Bułgarów. „Rynek będzie dżunglą”
data.description: Drożyzna staje się poważnym problemem społecznym w Bułgarii. Dotyczy szczególnie artykułów spożywczych, które są droższe niż w Polsce, mimo niższych płac. To efekt niskoskalowego rolnictwa oraz jednolitej stawki VAT na żywność.
data.translatedTitle: The high cost of living is overwhelming Bulgarians. "The market will be a jungle"
data.translatedDescription: Expenses are becoming a serious social problem in Bulgaria. This applies especially to food products, which are more expensive than in Poland, despite lower wages. This is the result of low-scale agriculture and a single VAT rate on food.

data.title: Rusza mundial kobiet do lat 20. Cel dla Polek? Grać tak długo, jak się da
data.description: Tak dużego turnieju kobiecej piłki nożnej w naszym kraju jeszcze nie było. W Katowicach, Sosnowcu, Bielsku-Białej i Łodzi rozpoczynają się mistrzostwa świata do lat 20. Polki zainaugurują je meczem z Argentyną.
data.translatedTitle: The U-20 Women's World Cup is starting. A goal for the Polish women? Play as long as you can
data.translatedDescription: There has never been such a large women's football tournament in our country. The U20 World Cup is starting in Katowice, Sosnowiec, Bielsko-Biała and Łódź. The Polish women will inaugurate it with a match against Argentina.

data.title: Jedenáctiletý chlapec utekl ve Vysokém Mýtě od rodiny, našel ho policejní pes
data.description: Policie v sobotu vyhlásila pátrání po jedenáctiletém chlapci, který v pátek okolo deváté hodiny večerní utekl z náměstí Přemysla Otakara II. ve Vysokém Mýtě, kde byl se svou rodinou. Ráno po deváté hodině policisté pátrání odvolali, chlapce našel služební pes.
data.translatedTitle: An eleven-year-old boy ran away from his family in Vysoké Mýto, a police dog found him
data.translatedDescription: On Saturday, the police announced a search for an eleven-year-old boy who ran away from Přemysl Otakar II Square on Friday around nine o'clock in the evening. in Vysoké Mýto, where he was with his family. In the morning after nine o'clock, the police called off the search, the boy was found by a service dog.

data.title: Většina Čechů odmítá schodek 389 miliard. U vládních voličů panuje rozkol
data.description: Navrhovaný schodek státního rozpočtu na příští rok ve výši 389 miliard korun považuje za nepřijatelný většina Čechů. Celkem 62 procent lidí ho má za příliš vysoký. Schodek ve vládou představené podobě přijímá 53 procent voličů hnutí ANO, u koaličních Motoristů a SPD ale jen přibližně čtvrtina voličů. Vyplývá to z nejnovějšího průzkumu agentury Median.
data.translatedTitle: Most Czechs reject the deficit of 389 billion. There is a split in the government electorate
data.translatedDescription: The proposed deficit of the state budget for next year in the amount of 389 billion crowns is considered unacceptable by the majority of Czechs. A total of 62 percent of people consider it too high. The deficit in the form presented by the government is accepted by 53 percent of the voters of the ANO movement, but only about a quarter of the voters of the coalition Motorist and SPD. This follows from the latest survey by the Median agency.

data.title: Sídliště v Praze dostanou více sdílených kol. Umístění na periferii komplikuje terén
data.description: Lidé si od příštího roku v aplikaci Lítačka půjčí sdílená kola častěji. Momentálně se mohou projet dvakrát denně na 15 minut zdarma, denní počet jízd se však zdvojnásobí na čtyři. Město chce provozovatele také motivovat, aby se více zaměřili na sídliště a okrajové části metropole, kde podle místních radnic kola chybějí.
data.translatedTitle: Housing estates in Prague will get more shared bikes. The location on the periphery complicates the terrain
data.translatedDescription: Starting next year, people will rent shared bikes more often in the Lítačka application. Currently, they can ride twice a day for 15 minutes for free, but the number of rides per day will double to four. The city also wants to motivate operators to focus more on housing estates and peripheral parts of the metropolis, where, according to local town halls, bicycles are lacking.

data.title: Pád v rakouských Alpách nepřežila dvaadvacetiletá Češka
data.description: Dvaadvacetiletá Češka v pátek zahynula po pádu ve skalnatém terénu u hory Grosser Bösenstein v Rakousku. Na túře byla se svým otcem. Podle rakouských médií žena nešťastně upadla, nikdo další nehodu nezavinil.
data.translatedTitle: A twenty-two-year-old Czech woman did not survive the fall in the Austrian Alps
data.translatedDescription: A 22-year-old Czech woman died on Friday after falling in rocky terrain near the Grosser Bösenstein mountain in Austria. She was hiking with her father. According to the Austrian media, the woman had an unfortunate fall, and no one was to blame for the other accident.

data.title: Přijeďte, prosí Nepál turisty. Země zoufale potřebuje jejich peníze
data.description: Nepál vyzval zahraniční turisty, aby kvůli ničivým povodním nerušili své cesty do Himálaje. Země se totiž obává, že vedle zničené infrastruktury přijde také o významnou část příjmů z cestovního ruchu. Škody přitom podle vlády dosahují zhruba pěti miliard dolarů.
data.translatedTitle: Come, Nepal begs tourists. The country desperately needs their money
data.translatedDescription: Nepal has urged foreign tourists not to cancel their trips to the Himalayas due to the devastating floods. The country fears that, in addition to the destroyed infrastructure, it will also lose a significant part of the income from tourism. At the same time, according to the government, the damage amounts to about five billion dollars.

data.title: Jako vysadit dva miliony stromů. Cementárna bude víc eko díky lince za miliardu
data.description: Společnost Holcim Česko otevřela v cementárně v Čížkovicích na Litoměřicku novou linku na zpracování kalcinovaných jílů, která využívá unikátní technologii patentovanou mateřskou skupinou. Jde o první linku na tento materiál ve střední a východní Evropě a zároveň největší investici v historii Holcim Česko v hodnotě přibližně jedné miliardy korun.
data.translatedTitle: Like planting two million trees. The cement plant will be more eco-friendly thanks to the billion dollar line
data.translatedDescription: The Holcim Česko company opened a new calcined clay processing line at the cement plant in Čížkovice in Litoměřice, which uses unique technology patented by the parent group. It is the first line for this material in Central and Eastern Europe and at the same time the largest investment in the history of Holcim Czech Republic, worth approximately one billion crowns.

data.title: Aristokratický frontman. Připomeňte si nedožité osmdesátiny Freddieho Mercuryho
data.description: Před osmdesáti lety se v Zanzibaru narodil chlapec Farrokh Bulsara, kterého později celý svět znal jako Freddieho Mercuryho, zpěváka kapely Queen. Byl to jeden z nejcharismatičtějších frontmanů, kterého kdy svět populární hudby poznal. Vynikající zpěvák i skladatel. Na pódiu mu ležel celý svět u nohou, v soukromí šlo o citlivého introverta, který si k sobě blíž kromě milovaných koček pustil jen málokoho.
data.translatedTitle: Aristocratic frontman. Remember the late eighties of Freddie Mercury
data.translatedDescription: Eighty years ago, a boy, Farrokh Bulsara, was born in Zanzibar, whom the whole world later knew as Freddie Mercury, the singer of the band Queen. He was one of the most charismatic frontmen the world of popular music has ever known. Excellent singer and songwriter. On stage, the whole world lay at his feet, in private he was a sensitive introvert who only let few people close to him except his beloved cats.

data.title: Ostravská zoo vypustila do přírody desítky supů a v září chystá jejich den
data.description: Ostravská zoo se v sobotu 5. září zapojí do oslav Mezinárodního dne pro supy. Návštěvníkům nabídne program, dětské kvízy i speciální komentovanou prohlídku zakončenou krmením dravců. Akce má za cíl upozornit na roli těchto ohrožených mrchožroutů v přírodě a představit záchranné projekty, díky kterým už Zoo Ostrava vypustila do volné přírody téměř čtyři desítky supů.
data.translatedTitle: The Ostrava Zoo released dozens of vultures into the wild and is preparing their day in September
data.translatedDescription: On Saturday, September 5, the Ostrava Zoo will participate in the celebration of International Vulture Day. Visitors will be offered a program, children's quizzes and a special guided tour ending with feeding the raptors. The aim of the event is to draw attention to the role of these endangered scavengers in nature and to present rescue projects, thanks to which the Ostrava Zoo has already released almost four dozen vultures into the wild.

data.title: Soud zamítl Trumpovo nařízení o korespondenční volbě, prezident se chce odvolat
data.description: Soudkyně federálního soudu v Bostonu Indira Talwaniová prodloužila zákaz, který brání americké poštovní službě USPS zavést opatření prezidenta Donalda Trumpa omezující korespondenční hlasování v listopadových volbách do Kongresu. Rozhodnutí představuje další překážku pro Trumpovu administrativu v době, kdy jednotlivé státy začínají rozesílat hlasovací lístky.
data.translatedTitle: Court rejects Trump's order on postal voting, the president wants to appeal
data.translatedDescription: Boston federal judge Indira Talwani has extended a ban preventing the USPS from implementing President Donald Trump's measure limiting mail-in voting in November's congressional elections. The decision represents another hurdle for the Trump administration as states begin mailing out ballots.

data.title: Kolumbijka zakotvila v Praze. Práce s dětmi je pro ni poslání
data.description: Z Bogoty přes Londýn, Singapur a Hongkong až do Prahy. Catalina Gonzales-Got si v každé zemi znovu hledala své místo, budovala kariéru a poznávala, jak rozdílně svět nahlíží na ženy, rodinu i péči o malé děti. V rozhovoru pro iDNES.cz popisuje, co jí jednotlivé kultury daly, jak zvládala nové začátky a proč nakonec zakotvila právě v české metropoli.
data.translatedTitle: The Colombian landed in Prague. Working with children is her mission
data.translatedDescription: From Bogotá via London, Singapore and Hong Kong to Prague. Catalina Gonzales-Got found her place again in each country, building a career and learning how the world views women, family and caring for young children differently. In an interview for iDNES.cz, she describes what each culture gave her, how she coped with new beginnings and why she finally anchored in the Czech capital.

data.title: Hodní a zlí. AfD má dvě předvolební tváře. Může to být taktika
data.description: Před důležitými volbami v Sasku-Anhaltsku roste v AfD pnutí mezi dvěma jejími proudy. Může to být taktika, jak oslovit více voličů. Může se stát, že v nedělních volbách strana získá historickou většinu pro zformování vlády.
data.translatedTitle: The good and the bad. AfD has two pre-election faces. It could be a tactic
data.translatedDescription: Ahead of important elections in Saxony-Anhalt, tensions are growing in the AfD between its two currents. It can be a tactic to reach more voters. It may happen that in Sunday's elections the party will get a historic majority to form a government.

data.title: Výrobci chtějí zastavit megatendr na vlaky pro Prahu a Střední Čechy. Radní mají počkat
data.description: Začátkem příštího týdne budou zastupitelé Středočeského kraje jednat o podobě železniční dopravy na další tři desítky let. Zakázka za více než 150 miliard korun se tak neobešla bez stížností a připomínek k podobě a transparentnosti výběrového řízení. Po několika podnětech k antimonopolnímu úřadu (ÚOHS) se do sporu o to, jakými vlaky budou Pražané a lidé ze Středočeského kraje jezdit po roce 2029, vložil i spolek Fair Rail, který sdružuje část výrobců ucházejících se o lukrativní zakázku.
data.translatedTitle: Manufacturers want to stop the megatender for trains for Prague and Central Bohemia. Councilors have to wait
data.translatedDescription: At the beginning of next week, representatives of the Central Bohemian Region will discuss the form of rail transport for the next three decades. The contract for more than 150 billion crowns was not without complaints and comments about the form and transparency of the tender process. After several complaints to the Antimonopoly Office (ÚOHS), the Fair Rail association, which brings together some of the manufacturers bidding for the lucrative contract, also intervened in the dispute about which trains the people of Prague and the Central Bohemian Region will use after 2029.

data.title: Bitcoinová kauza: Jiřikovský rozeslal tisíc bitcoinů dřív, než za to „zaplatil“ státu
data.description: Byl čtvrtek 6. března 2025 odpoledne, krátce před půl druhou a Tomáš Jiřikovský, odsouzený provozovatel nelegálního tržiště, se připravoval na svůj „velký den“. Nazítří převedl ze svých bitcoinových peněženek, do kterých se policie nedokázala kvůli heslům dostat a počítače i s nimi po rozhodnutí soudu mu vrátila, 468 bitcoinů za téměř miliardu. Než to ale udělal, rozeslal právě to odpoledne o den dříve dalších více než tisíc bitcoinů za 2,2 miliardy korun na různé peněženky.
data.translatedTitle: Bitcoin case: Jiřikovský sent out a thousand bitcoins before "paying" the state for it
data.translatedDescription: It was Thursday, March 6, 2025 in the afternoon, shortly before half past two, and Tomáš Jiřikovský, a convicted operator of an illegal marketplace, was preparing for his "big day". The next day, he transferred 468 bitcoins for almost a billion from his bitcoin wallets, which the police couldn't get into because of the passwords, and the computers and them were returned to him after the court's decision. But before he did that, he sent more than a thousand bitcoins for 2.2 billion crowns to various wallets that very afternoon, a day earlier.

data.title: Češi popsali lanýže jako houby už ve 14. století, dvě stě let před Italy
data.description: Česko má možná mnohem delší lanýžovou historii, než se dosud myslelo. V Glosáři mistra Klareta z doby kolem roku 1360 se objevuje výraz „lanyss“ v části věnované houbám. Pokud označení skutečně odpovídá pravému lanýži, jde o mimořádně starý evropský doklad. Teprve o více než dvě století později pak totiž italský učenec Andrea Cesalpino popsal lanýže jako houby, což byl doposud nejstarší záznam o jejich zařazení.
data.translatedTitle: The Czechs described truffles as mushrooms already in the 14th century, two hundred years before the Italians
data.translatedDescription: The Czech Republic may have a much longer truffle history than previously thought. In Master Claret's Glossary from around 1360, the term "lanyss" appears in the section devoted to mushrooms. If the label does indeed correspond to a true truffle, it is an extremely old European document. It was only more than two centuries later that the Italian scholar Andrea Cesalpino described truffles as mushrooms, which was the oldest record of their classification to date.

data.title: Porota v USA se neshodla, soud s matkou obžalovanou z vraždy tří dětí neplatí
data.description: Americký soudce v pátekostře sledovaném procesu s Lindsay Clancyovou, která čelila obvinění z vraždy svých tří malých dětí v roce 2023, prohlásil soud za neplatný poté, co se porota nemohla shodnout na verdiktu. Obhajoba Clancyové, která nepopírá, že děti uškrtila, tvrdí, že ji k činu vedla poporodní psychóza.Proti prohlášení soudu za neplatný obhajoba odvolala, ale vrchní soud státu Massachusetts to zamítl. Prokuratura tak na základě dnešního rozhodnutí soudce může proces nastartovat znovu.
data.translatedTitle: The jury in the USA agreed, the trial with the mother accused of the murder of three children is not valid
data.translatedDescription: A US judge on Friday declared the trial of Lindsay Clancy, who faced charges of murdering her three young children in 2023, a mistrial after the jury could not agree on a verdict. The defense of Clancy, who does not deny that she strangled the children, claims that she was driven by postpartum psychosis. The defense appealed against the court's declaration of invalidity, but the Massachusetts Supreme Court rejected it. Based on today's judge's decision, the prosecutor's office can start the process again.

data.title: Putin nechce zaútočit na země NATO, prohlásil Trump
data.description: Americký prezident Donald Trump prohlásil, že ruský prezident Vladimir Putin nechce zaútočit na země Severoatlantické aliance. Šéf Bílého domu zároveň potvrdil, že američtí vyjednavači Steve Witkoff a Jared Kushner poletí do Ruska a na Ukrajinu s návrhem na ukončení války.
data.translatedTitle: Putin does not want to attack NATO countries, Trump said
data.translatedDescription: US President Donald Trump said that Russian President Vladimir Putin does not want to attack the countries of the North Atlantic Alliance. At the same time, the head of the White House confirmed that American negotiators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner will fly to Russia and Ukraine with a proposal to end the war.

data.title: „Francie už nebude migrační branou do Británie.“ Bardella a Farage se dohodli
data.description: Pokud Národní sdružení zvítězí ve francouzských prezidentských volbách, Francie přestane být pro migranty vstupní branou do Velké Británie. V pátek to řekl šéf strany Jordan Bardella na konferenci se zástupci podobně protimigračně orientované britské strany Reform UK. Obě strany uzavřely dohodu, jež má v případě jejich volebního úspěchu umožnit Británii vracet migranty přes Lamanšský průliv.
data.translatedTitle: "France will no longer be a migration gateway to Britain." Bardella and Farage agreed
data.translatedDescription: If the National Association wins the French presidential election, France will cease to be a gateway for migrants to Great Britain. On Friday, party leader Jordan Bardella said this at a conference with representatives of the similarly anti-immigration British party Reform UK. The two sides have reached an agreement to allow Britain to return migrants across the English Channel if they win the election.

ner.label: ORG

data.title: Orlík „vyschnul“. Vodu ve Vltavě začaly poprvé v historii doplňovat Slapy
data.description: Orlická přehrada v pátek kvůli extrémnímu hydrologickému suchu začala snižovat odtok. Hladina v ní klesla o 15 metrů oproti běžné úrovni. Nádrž teď začne vypouštět jen stejné množství vody, které do ní přitéká, což je nyní zhruba 15 metrů krychlových za sekundu. Do Vltavy v Praze ale poteče stejně jako předtím potřebných 40 metrů krychlových vody za sekundu.
data.translatedTitle: The eagle "dried up". For the first time in history, Slapy began to replenish the water in the Vltava
data.translatedDescription: On Friday, the Orlická dam began to reduce the outflow due to extreme hydrological drought. The water level in it dropped by 15 meters compared to the normal level. The tank will now start releasing only the same amount of water that flows into it, which is now roughly 15 cubic meters per second. However, the required 40 cubic meters of water per second will flow into the Vltava in Prague, just as before.

data.title: „Stabilita je podmínka, ne rekord.“ Meloniová chválí svou vládu, podle opozice není za co
data.description: Italská premiérka Giorgia Meloniová v pátek za výsledky pochválila svou vládu, která se stala nejdéle vládnoucím kabinetem v Itálii od roku 1946. Podle ní koalice úspěšně pracovala na podpoře hospodářského růstu a posílení mezinárodního kreditu Itálie. Opačného názoru je opozice, podle níž se Meloniová zavřela do vládních paláců a Italové nemají vůbec co slavit.
data.translatedTitle: "Stability is a condition, not a record." Meloniová praises her government, according to the opposition, it is not for nothing
data.translatedDescription: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni on Friday praised the results of her government, which has become Italy's longest-ruling cabinet since 1946. According to her, the coalition has worked successfully to support economic growth and strengthen Italy's international credit. The opposition is of the opposite opinion, according to which Meloni has locked herself in government palaces and Italians have nothing to celebrate at all.

data.title: Ochráníme vás, vzkázali Norové osiřelým Rusům ze zadržené lodi
data.description: Norsko chce pomoci Rusům, kteří uvázli na Špicberkách poté, co norské úřady na žádost Ukrajiny zadržely ruskou loď převážející na souostroví pasažéry a zásoby. V pátek o tom informovalo norské ministerstvo zahraničí.
data.translatedTitle: We will protect you, the Norwegians told the orphaned Russians from the captured ship
data.translatedDescription: Norway wants to help Russians stranded on Svalbard after Norwegian authorities detained a Russian ship carrying passengers and supplies to the archipelago at the request of Ukraine. The Norwegian Ministry of Foreign Affairs informed about this on Friday.

data.title: Londýn připravil Freddiemu Mercurymu poctu. Zpěvákovi by bylo 80

data.title: Afrika větší, Rusko menší. OSN schválila překreslení staletí používané mapy světa
data.description: Afrika na většině používaných map vypadá mnohem menší, než ve skutečnosti je. Valné shromáždění OSN proto v pátek jednalo o návrhu Toga, které chce prosadit přesnější mapu světa a postupně opustit staletí starou Mercatorovu projekci. Ta například staví rozlohou nesrovnatelné Afriku a Grónsko téměř na stejnou úroveň. Valné shromáždění OSN rezoluci schválilo.
data.translatedTitle: Africa bigger, Russia smaller. The United Nations has approved the redrawing of the centuries-old map of the world
data.translatedDescription: Africa appears much smaller on most maps than it actually is. Therefore, on Friday, the UN General Assembly discussed Togo's proposal, which wants to promote a more accurate map of the world and gradually abandon the centuries-old Mercator projection. For example, it puts Africa and Greenland, which are incomparable in area, almost on the same level. The UN General Assembly approved the resolution.

data.description: Americké ministerstvo obrany dočasně stáhlo nedávno publikované pokyny o povinném testování hladiny testosteronu vojáků starších 30 let. S odkazem na nejmenovaný zdroj o tom napsala agentura Reuters. Ve středu zveřejnil Pentagon na svých webových stránkách "Klinické pokyny pro optimalizaci zdraví a lidské výkonnosti". Dokument a doprovodné prohlášení mluvčího Seana Parnella ale náhle zmizely.

data.translatedDescription: The U.S. Department of Defense has temporarily withdrawn recently published guidance on mandatory testosterone testing of soldiers over the age of 30. Referring to an unnamed source, Reuters wrote about it. On Wednesday, the Pentagon published "Clinical Guidelines for Optimizing Health and Human Performance" on its website. But the document and accompanying statement from spokesman Sean Parnell suddenly disappeared.

data.title: Hackeři berlínským úřadům ukradli citlivá data, nyní je zveřejnili na darknetu
data.description: Vyděrači z hackerské skupiny Rhysida zveřejnili data ukradená při hackerském útoku na berlínské správní úřady. Od správy německé metropole po vypršení ultimáta nedostali požadované výkupné. Podle regionální rozhlasové stanice RBB24 zveřejnili na takzvaném darknetu ke stažení zhruba 1,4 milionu dat v několika balících.
data.translatedTitle: Hackers have stolen sensitive data from Berlin authorities, now published it on the darknet
data.translatedDescription: Extortionists from the Rhysida hacking group have released the data stolen in the hacking attack on the Berlin administrative offices. From the administration of the German capital, after the expiration of the ultimatum, they did not receive the required ransom. According to the regional radio station RBB24, they published about 1.4 million data in several packages on the so-called darknet for download.

data.title: Německo šetří další sabotáž. Je za ní klimatický aktivista, oznámil ministr
data.description: Německá policie čtvrteční nález podezřelého předmětu u elektrické stanice v Dormagenu na západě země vyšetřuje jako sabotáž. Spolkový ministr vnitra oznámil, že podezřelým je klimatický aktivista. Vyšetřovatelé mají dva dopisy, kterými se údajný pachatel hlásí k odpovědnosti. Na jejich základě zkontrolovala policie další dvě elektrická zařízení. Německo v posledních dnech zaznamenalo jiné dva útoky na elektrické rozvodny.
data.translatedTitle: Germany is saving for another sabotage. A climate activist is behind her, the minister announced
data.translatedDescription: The German police are investigating Thursday's discovery of a suspicious object at the power station in Dormagen in the west of the country as sabotage. The Federal Minister of the Interior announced that the suspect is a climate activist. Investigators have two letters in which the alleged perpetrator claims responsibility. On their basis, the police checked two other electrical devices. Germany has seen two other attacks on electricity substations in recent days.

data.title: Převrácení panceřované tatry policie prověřuje jako ublížení na zdraví z nedbalosti
data.description: Policisté prověřují sobotní převrácení pancéřovaného vozidla Tatra Tadeas v Lešanech na Benešovsku jako ublížení na zdraví z nedbalosti. Nehoda se stala v areálu Vojenského technického muzea a zranili se při ní dva lidé. Kriminalisté budou zjišťovat, do jaké míry se na události podílel řidič a způsob jeho jízdy. Zatím neodhalili žádnou závadu na vozidle, řekl policejní mluvčí Pavel Truxa.
data.translatedTitle: The overturning of the armored Tatras is being investigated by the police as an injury caused by negligence
data.translatedDescription: Police officers are investigating Saturday's overturning of the Tatra Tadeas armored vehicle in Lešany in the Benešovsk region as a negligent injury. The accident happened on the grounds of the Military Technical Museum and two people were injured. Criminal investigators will investigate to what extent the driver was involved in the incident and the manner of his driving. So far, they have not discovered any defects on the vehicle, said police spokesman Pavel Truxa.

data.translatedTitle: Trump sends Witkoff and Kushner to Moscow and Kiev with peace proposal
data.translatedDescription: US special envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, Donald Trump's son-in-law, are on their way to Russia and Ukraine to present a proposal to end the war in Ukraine, the US President told journalists on Friday, confirming information released by the press hours earlier.

data.title: Emmanouil Karalis `voa` para o triunfo no salto com vara na Liga de Diamante
data.description: O grego Emmanouil ‘Manolo’ Karalis aproveitou hoje a ausência de última hora do recordista mundial Armand Duplantis para vencer a final do concurso de salto com vara da Liga de Diamante, em Bruxelas.
data.translatedTitle: Emmanouil Karalis `voa` para o triumpho no leap com vara na Liga de Diamante
data.translatedDescription: Greek Emmanouil ‘Manolo’ Karalis today took advantage of the last-minute absence of world record holder Armand Duplantis to win the final of the Diamond League pole vault competition in Brussels.

data.title: Carneiro acusa Governo de ganhar com aumento dos combustíveis e quer baixar IVA
data.description: O secretário-geral do PS, José Luís Carneiro, acusou hoje o Governo de ganhar dinheiro com o aumento dos combustíveis e revelou ter entregado na quinta-feira, no Parlamento, uma proposta de redução do IVA para os combustíveis e alimentos.
data.translatedTitle: Carneiro accuses the Government of gaining from increased fuel prices and wants to lower VAT
data.translatedDescription: The secretary general of the PS, José Luís Carneiro, today accused the government of making money from the increase in fuel prices and revealed that he had submitted a proposal to reduce VAT on fuel and food in Parliament on Thursday.

data.title: Irão. Trump volta a ameaçar atacar a montanha de Kolang "muito em breve"
data.description: O presidente norte-americano voltou a afirmar que os EUA podem atacar a instalação iraniana altamente fortificada "muito em breve", depois de ter desvalorizado o conflito com o Irão, descrevendo-o como "coisa pequena".
data.translatedTitle: Iran. Trump threatens again to attack Kolang mountain "very soon"
data.translatedDescription: The American president once again stated that the US could attack the highly fortified Iranian facility "very soon", after having downplayed the conflict with Iran, describing it as a "small thing".

data.title: João Neves e treinador Luis Enrique renovam contratos com Paris Saint-Germain
data.description: O futebolista internacional português João Neves e o treinador espanhol Luis Enrique renovaram contratos com o Paris Saint-Germain até 2031 e 2030, respetivamente, anunciou hoje o pentacampeão francês e bicampeão europeu, estendendo as ligações de mais quatro jogadores.
data.translatedTitle: João Neves and coach Luis Enrique renew contracts with Paris Saint-Germain
data.translatedDescription: Portuguese international footballer João Neves and Spanish coach Luis Enrique have renewed contracts with Paris Saint-Germain until 2031 and 2030, respectively, the five-time French champion and two-time European champion announced today, extending the ties of four more players.

data.title: Montenegro indica que desconto nos combustíveis já ronda 700 ME
data.description: O primeiro-ministro indicou hoje que o desconto no imposto sobre os combustíveis já soma "cerca de 700 milhões de euros" em 2026 e admitiu novas medidas se os preços se mantiverem ao nível das últimas quatro semanas.
data.translatedTitle: Montenegro indicates that the discount on fuel is already around 700 ME
data.translatedDescription: The Prime Minister indicated today that the discount on fuel tax already amounts to "around 700 million euros" in 2026 and admitted new measures if prices remain at the level of the last four weeks.

data.title: Carneiro acusa Governo de ganhar dinheiro com os combustíveis
data.description: José Luís Carneiro diz que os portugueses têm de saber que o Executivo de Montenegro está mesmo a ganhar dinheiro com o aumento do preço dos combustíveis. Na Póvoa de Varzim, o líder do PS acusou p primeiro-ministro de incompetência e insensibilidade.
data.translatedTitle: Carneiro accuses the Government of making money from fuel
data.translatedDescription: José Luís Carneiro says that the Portuguese need to know that the Montenegro Executive is actually making money from the increase in fuel prices. In Póvoa de Varzim, the PS leader accused the prime minister of incompetence and insensitivity.

data.title: Porto exige metrobus pronto em dezembro após "incumprimento de prazos" do empreiteiro
data.description: O presidente da Câmara do Porto deu até ao final do ano para o empreiteiro terminar as obras da segunda fase do metrobus, falando em "incumprimento de prazos" do construtor, que "não tem cumprido com as suas obrigações".
data.translatedTitle: Porto demands metrobus ready in December after contractor's "failure to meet deadlines"
data.translatedDescription: The mayor of Porto gave the contractor until the end of the year to complete the works on the second phase of the metrobus, speaking of "non-compliance with deadlines" by the builder, who "has not fulfilled his obligations".

data.title: Filme Jacaré
data.description: Depois da estreia mundial no Festival de Cinema de Locarno, "O Jacaré" do realizador Basil da Cunha chega aos cinemas portugueses.
data.translatedTitle: Alligator Movie
data.translatedDescription: After its world premiere at the Locarno Festival, "O Jacaré" by director Basil da Cunha arrives in Portuguese cinemas.

data.title: Líder da UNITA acusa regime de intensificar intolerância política em Angola
data.description: O líder da UNITA, maior partido da oposição angolana, acusou hoje "o regime que governa Angola" de estar a intensificar atos de intolerância política, "com marcas de violência que envergonham o Estado e ferem a dignidade dos cidadãos".
data.translatedTitle: UNITA leader accuses regime of intensifying political intolerance in Angola
data.translatedDescription: The leader of UNITA, the largest Angolan opposition party, today accused "the regime that governs Angola" of intensifying acts of political intolerance, "with marks of violence that shame the State and harm the dignity of citizens".

data.title: Mais turmas sem professores este ano do que no ano passado
data.description: São perto do dobro os horários por preencher, sobretudo professores do primeiro ciclo. Lisboa é mais uma vez o distrito com mais dificuldade em contratar.
data.translatedTitle: More classes without teachers this year than last year
data.translatedDescription: The number of unfilled timetables is almost twice as high, especially first cycle teachers. Lisbon is once again the district with the most difficulty in hiring.

data.title: Reestruturação da APA e do ICNF "praticamente pronta" diz ministra do Ambiente
data.description: A ministra do Ambiente, Maria da Graça Carvalho, garantiu que a reestruturação da Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente e do Instituto da Conservação da Natureza e das Florestas está «praticamente pronta», devendo em breve chegar a Conselho de Ministros.
data.translatedTitle: Reestruturação da APA e do ICNF "praticamente pronta" diz ministra do Ambiente
data.translatedDescription: The Minister of the Environment, Maria da Graça Carvalho, guaranteed that the restructuring of the Portuguese Environment Agency and the Institute for the Conservation of Nature and Forests is "practically ready", and should soon reach the Council of Ministers.

data.title: Dona Estefânia sem anestesistas. Ordem dos Médicos pede reunião urgente no Ministério da Saúde
data.description: O pedido feito na sequência da notícia avançada pela RTP sobre a demissão de nove chefes de serviço da urgência do Hospital pediátrico Dona Estefânia, saída em bloco causada pela falta de anestesistas.
data.translatedTitle: Dona Estefânia sem anestesistas. Ordem dos Médicos pede reunião urgente no Ministério da Saúde
data.translatedDescription: The request was made following the news released by RTP about the dismissal of nine heads of emergency service at the Dona Estefânia pediatric hospital, a massive departure caused by the lack of anesthetists.

data.title: Cabo submarino entre Portugal e Marrocos só com financiamento privado ou da UE
data.description: A construção de um cabo elétrico submarino entre Portugal e Marrocos é uma possibilidade, mas só avançará com financiamento de privados ou da União Europeia, garantiu hoje a ministra do Ambiente.
data.translatedTitle: Cabo submarino entre Portugal e Marrocos só com financiamento privado ou da UE
data.translatedDescription: The construction of a submarine electrical cable between Portugal and Morocco is a possibility, but it will only go ahead with financing from private companies or the European Union, the Minister of the Environment assured today.

data.title: Atacado acampamento em Moçambique que é propriedade de Carlos Queiroz
data.description: Pelo menos três norte-americanos foram retirados de um acampamento de caça no norte de Moçambique após ataque de um grupo armado. O acampamento é copropriedade do treinador Carlos Queiroz, que atualmente orienta a seleção do Gana.
data.translatedTitle: Atacado acampamento em Moçambique que é propriedade de Carlos Queiroz
data.translatedDescription: At least three Americans were removed from a hunting camp in northern Mozambique after an attack by an armed group. The camp is co-owned by coach Carlos Queiroz, who currently coaches the Ghana national team.

data.title: Quinta-feira foi o quarto dia mais quente de setembro em 85 anos diz IPMA
data.description: A passada quinta-feira foi o quarto dia mais quente de setembro em 85 anos, tendo-se registado em Alcochete o valor mais alto da temperatura máxima de 44,3 graus Celsius, avançou hoje o IPMA.
data.translatedTitle: Quinta-feira foi o quarto dia mais quente de setembro em 85 anos diz IPMA
data.translatedDescription: Last Thursday was the fourth hottest day of September in 85 years, with the highest maximum temperature of 44.3 degrees Celsius being recorded in Alcochete, the IPMA said today.

data.title: DGS aconselha mais vulneráveis a protegerem-se das poeiras africanas
data.description: A forte concentração de poeiras do norte de África provocou um alerta da Direcão-Geral de Saúde. A qualidade do ar nesta altura é muito fraca e as pessoas mais vulnerávies devem ficar em casa até domingo.
data.translatedTitle: DGS aconselha mais vulneráveis a protegerem-se das poeiras africanas
data.translatedDescription: The strong concentration of dust in North Africa provoked a warning from the General Directorate of Health. The air quality at this time is very bad and the most vulnerable people should stay at home until Sunday.

data.title: MOTELX 20ª edição do Festival Internacional de Cinema de Terror de Lisboa é a maior de sempre
data.description: A edição 20 do MOTELX, Festival Internacional de Cinema de Terror de Lisboa é a maior de sempre. Realiza-se de 30 a 13 de setembro no Cinema São Jorge, em Lisboa, pela primeira vez são 11 dias de festival. A Cinemateca Portuguesa vai receber a seção "Lost in Europe: O Terror por Detrás da Cortina de Ferro".
data.translatedTitle: MOTELX 20ª edição do Festival Internacional de Cinema de Terror de Lisboa é a maior de sempre
data.translatedDescription: The 20th edition of MOTELX, the Lisbon International Horror Film Festival, is the biggest of all time. It takes place from the 30th to the 13th of September at Cinema São Jorge, in Lisbon, for the first time there are 11 days of festival. The Cinemateca Portuguesa will host the section "Lost in Europe: The Terror Behind the Iron Curtain".

data.title: Supremo brasileiro enfrenta a sua maior crise
data.description: Revelações ligadas à derrocada de um banco envolvem juízes e figuras de topo da política brasileira. Um escândalo de favorecimento e promiscuidade de poderes.
data.translatedTitle: Supremo brasileiro enfrenta a sua maior crise
data.translatedDescription: Revelations linked to the collapse of a bank involve judges and top figures in Brazilian politics. A scandal of favoritism and promiscuity of powers.

data.title: Poemas da natureza de Capicua e BD premiada de Tessa Hulls entre novidades da Penguin
data.description: Livros ilustrados de Capicua e das jornalistas Diana Matias e Miriam Alves e uma BD de memórias da autora Tessa Hulls, premiada com o Pulitzer, estão entre as novidades da Penguin Random House até outubro.
data.translatedTitle: Poemas da natureza de Capicua e BD premiada de Tessa Hulls entre novidades da Penguin
data.translatedDescription: Illustrated books by Capicua and journalists Diana Matias and Miriam Alves and a memoir comic by Pulitzer Prize-winning author Tessa Hulls are among the new offerings from Penguin Random House until October.

data.title: Doentes sem cirurgias. Diretor executivo do SNS recusa alterar regras
data.description: Estão a ser canceladas centenas de cirurgias em ortopedia e também tratamentos em oftalmologia. É o resultado do protesto dos médicos contra os novos valores pagos em horas extra. O diretor executivo do SNS não admite alterar as novas regras mesmo com doentes prejudicados.
data.translatedTitle: Doentes sem cirurgias. Diretor executivo do SNS recusa alterar regras
data.translatedDescription: Hundreds of orthopedic surgeries and ophthalmology treatments are being cancelled. It is the result of doctors' protest against the new amounts paid in overtime. The executive director of SUS does not admit changing the new rules even with affected patients.

data.title: Paulo Raimundo acusa Chega de atirar ao lado com moção
data.description: Paulo Raimundo diz que o Chega "passa ao lado" das razões que deveriam justificar uma moção de censura ao Governo. Na abertura da Festa do Avante, o secretário-geral do PCP criticou ainda a resposta do Executivo à subida do preço dos combustíveis.
data.translatedTitle: Paulo Raimundo acusa Chega de atirar ao lado com moção
data.translatedDescription: Paulo Raimundo says that Chega "misses" the reasons that should justify a motion of censure against the Government. At the opening of the Festa do Avante, the secretary general of the PCP also criticized the Executive's response to the rise in fuel prices.

data.title: Sporting inscreve Alexandropoulos na Liga, que recebeu 35 registos até às 18h00
data.description: O Sporting inscreveu o grego Sotiris Alexandropulos na Liga Portuguesa de Futebol Profissional, no último dia do mercado de transferências, informou o organismo, que recebeu 35 inscrições até às 18h00 de hoje.
data.translatedTitle: Sporting inscreve Alexandropoulos na Liga, que recebeu 35 registos até às 18h00
data.translatedDescription: Sporting registered the Greek Sotiris Alexandropulos in the Portuguese Professional Football League, on the last day of the transfer market, informed the entity, which received 35 registrations until 6pm today.

data.title: Governo acusa Chega de "coreografia política"
data.description: O Governo acusa o Chega de "coreografia política" face à moção de censura que entregou no Parlamento. O primeiro-ministro promete só voltar a falar sobre o assunto na terça-feira. O Presidente vai assistir durante as férias à dicussão e votação da moção de censura.
data.translatedTitle: Governo acusa Chega de "coreografia política"
data.translatedDescription: The Government accuses Chega of "political choreography" in light of the motion of censure he tabled in Parliament. The prime minister promises to only speak about the matter again on Tuesday. The President will attend the discussion and vote on the motion of censure during the holidays.

data.title: Armand Duplantis sente incómodo na perna e falha final da Liga de Diamante
data.description: O sueco Armand Duplantis, recordista mundial do salto com vara, falhou hoje a final da Liga de Diamante, em Bruxelas, devido a um incómodo na perna antes do início do concurso.
data.translatedTitle: Armand Duplantis sente incómodo na perna e falha final da Liga de Diamante
data.translatedDescription: Swedish Armand Duplantis, world record holder in the pole vault, missed the Diamond League final in Brussels today due to a problem in his leg before the start of the competition.

data.title: Fatoumata Diallo sexta nos 400 metros barreiras na final da Liga Diamante
data.description: A atleta portuguesa Fatoumata Diallo terminou hoje na sexta posição a prova de 400 metros barreiras da final da Liga Diamante, em Bruxelas, com um tempo de 53,90 segundos.
data.translatedTitle: Fatoumata Diallo sexta nos 400 metros barreiras na final da Liga Diamante
data.translatedDescription: Portuguese athlete Fatoumata Diallo finished sixth today in the 400-meter hurdles race at the Diamond League final, in Brussels, with a time of 53.90 seconds.

data.title: ERSE deve ter "competência sancionatória" no mercado dos combustíveis indica ministra do Ambiente
data.description: Maria da Graça Carvalho enviou uma carta à ERSE, pedindo transparência na formação dos preços e que esta entidade reguladora "aprofunde" as suas competências para poder vir a sancionar quem viole a legislação do setor.
data.translatedTitle: ERSE deve ter "competência sancionatória" no mercado dos combustíveis indica ministra do Ambiente
data.translatedDescription: Maria da Graça Carvalho sent a letter to ERSE, asking for transparency in price formation and for this regulatory entity to "deepen" its powers to be able to sanction those who violate the sector's legislation.

data.title: 19h Combustível verde também vai ter apoio
data.translatedTitle: 19h Combustível verde também vai ter apoio

data.title: Dirigentes do Reform UK renunciam após escândalo na extrema-direita britânica
data.description: James Orr e Dan Jukes, assessores de Nigel Farage no Reform UK, renunciaram aos seus cargos esta sexta-feira. O partido de extrema-direita está envolvido num escândalo de financiamento, divulgado pela televisão pública britânica.
data.translatedTitle: Dirigentes do Reform UK renunciam após escândalo na extrema-direita britânica
data.translatedDescription: James Orr and Dan Jukes, advisors to Nigel Farage at Reform UK, resigned from their positions this Friday. The far-right party is involved in a funding scandal, reported on British public television.

data.title: ONU aprova alteração dos mapas mundiais para melhor refletir dimensão de África
data.description: A Assembleia-Geral das Nações Unidas aprovou hoje uma resolução, apresentada pelo Togo e apoiada pela União Africana (UA), que promove uma representação mais precisa nos mapas das áreas terrestres dos continentes, nomeadamente de África.
data.translatedTitle: ONU aprova alteração dos mapas mundiais para melhor refletir dimensão de África
data.translatedDescription: The United Nations General Assembly today approved a resolution, presented by Togo and supported by the African Union (AU), which promotes a more accurate representation on maps of the land areas of the continents, particularly Africa.

data.title: 18h30 Atletas suspensos com apostas e arranque da jornada
data.translatedTitle: 18h30 Atletas suspensos com apostas e arranque da jornada

data.title: Extremo Chipyoka Songa reforça Moreirense até 2031
data.description: O extremo Chipyoka Songa reforçou o Moreirense, com um contrato válido até 2031, após três épocas a jogar em Israel, anunciou o clube da I Liga portuguesa de futebol, em nota no sítio oficial.
data.translatedTitle: Extremo Chipyoka Songa reforça Moreirense até 2031
data.translatedDescription: Winger Chipyoka Songa joined Moreirense, with a contract valid until 2031, after three seasons playing in Israel, the Portuguese football I League club announced in a statement on the official website.

data.title: Médio Milan Robin assina pelo Estoril Praia até 2029
data.description: O Estoril Praia, da I Liga portuguesa de futebol, anunciou a contratação do médio francês Milan Robin, proveniente do Le Mans, num contrato válido até 2029.
data.translatedTitle: Médio Milan Robin assina pelo Estoril Praia até 2029
data.translatedDescription: Estoril Praia, from the Portuguese First Football League, announced the signing of French midfielder Milan Robin, from Le Mans, on a contract valid until 2029.

data.title: 18h Combustíveis: transportes garantem que não aguentam mais subidas
data.translatedTitle: 18h Combustíveis: transportes garantem que não aguentam mais subidas

data.title: FC Porto com vitória suada sobre Moreirense
data.description: O FC Porto bateu o Moreirense no Estádio do Dragão, por 2-1, depois de ter estado a perder, e continua só com triunfos, em jogo que abriu a jornada cinco do I Liga.
data.translatedTitle: FC Porto com vitória suada sobre Moreirense
data.translatedDescription: FC Porto beat Moreirense at Estádio do Dragão, 2-1, after losing, and continues with only triumphs, in a game that opened round five of the I Liga.

data.title: Nuno Borges eliminado na primeira ronda de pares
data.description: O tenista português Nuno Borges, que jogou com o australiano Rinky Hijikata, foi hoje eliminado na estreia em pares do US Open, quarto Grand Slam da temporada, ao perder com o norte-americano Robert Cash e o austríaco Alexander Erler.
data.translatedTitle: Nuno Borges eliminado na primeira ronda de pares
data.translatedDescription: Portuguese tennis player Nuno Borges, who played with Australian Rinky Hijikata, was eliminated today in his doubles debut at the US Open, the fourth Grand Slam of the season, after losing to North American Robert Cash and Austrian Alexander Erler.

data.title: Ministra da Justiça. "Não é do interesse de ninguém" atrasar investigações sobre Luís Neves
data.description: A ministra da Justiça diz que não é o Governo que está a fragilizar a imagem da Polícia Judiciária. Rita Alarcão Júdice espera que até ao fim do ano estejam concluidos os inquéritos abertos a Luís Neves e diz que "não é do interesse de ninguém" atrasar qualquer investigação sobre o ministro da Administração Interna.
data.translatedTitle: Ministra da Justiça. "Não é do interesse de ninguém" atrasar investigações sobre Luís Neves
data.translatedDescription: The Minister of Justice says that it is not the Government that is weakening the image of the Judicial Police. Rita Alarcão Júdice hopes that the investigations opened into Luís Neves will be completed by the end of the year and says that "it is not in anyone's interest" to delay any investigation into the Minister of Internal Administration.

data.title: Η τελευταία βόλτα της Μαρίνας Σπανού στον δρόμο
data.description: Η Μαρίνα Σπανού ολοκλήρωσε τον κύκλο των συναυλιών δρόμου, με τις οποίες τη γνωρίσαμε το 2020, με ένα μεγάλο live στην πλατεία Ασωμάτων. Το ΒΗΜΑ Encore ήταν εκεί και μέσα από συνεντεύξεις, backstage πλάνα και αρχειακό υλικό καταγράφει τη διαδρομή της τραγουδοποιού.
data.translatedTitle: Η τελευταία βόλτα της Μαρίνας Σπανού στον δρόμο
data.translatedDescription: Marina Spanou completed the cycle of street concerts, with which we met her in 2020, with a big live in Asomaton square. BHIMA Encore was there and through interviews, backstage footage and archival material records the singer's journey.

data.title: Στρατιώτες… κατά λάθος: Πώς η Ρωσία εξαπατά ξένους πολίτες για τον πόλεμο στην Ουκρανία
data.description: Η Ρωσία συνεχίζει να στρατολογεί μαζικά υπηκόους ξένων κρατών για τον πόλεμο κατά της Ουκρανίας. Οι ίδιοι δεν το γνωρίζουν.
data.translatedTitle: Στρατιώτες… κατά λάθος: Πώς η Ρωσία εξαπατά ξένους πολίτες για τον πόλεμο στην Ουκρανία
data.translatedDescription: Russia continues to massively recruit foreign nationals for its war against Ukraine. They don't know it themselves.

data.title: ΔΕΘ 2026: Το τροχόσπιτο, το μονοθέσιο της Ferrari και τα κεράσματα στον Κ. Μητσοτάκη
data.description: Στις εγκαταστάσεις της 90ής ΔΕΘ βρίσκεται από τις 10:00 το πρωί ο Κυριάκος Μητσοτάκης. Ο πρωθυπουργός παρέστη στον αγιασμό, συναντήθηκε με τη διοίκηση της ΔΕΘ-Helexpo και έκανε βόλτα στα εκθεσιακά περίπτερα.
data.translatedTitle: ΔΕΘ 2026: Το τροχόσπιτο, το μονοθέσιο της Ferrari και τα κεράσματα στον Κ. Μητσοτάκη
data.translatedDescription: Kyriakos Mitsotakis has been at the premises of the 90th TIF since 10:00 in the morning. The prime minister attended the consecration, met with the management of TIF-Helexpo and walked around the exhibition stands.

data.title: Ο μυστήριος Τζον Τέρνους είναι έτοιμος να ανέβει το βουνό της Apple
data.description: Ο άνθρωπος που ανέλαβε τα ηνία της Apple καλείται να σώσει την παρτίδα της τεχνητής νοημοσύνης. Παραμένει, ωστόσο, ένας γρίφος για την αγορά.
data.translatedTitle: Ο μυστήριος Τζον Τέρνους είναι έτοιμος να ανέβει το βουνό της Apple
data.translatedDescription: The man who took over the reins of Apple is called upon to save the artificial intelligence batch. It remains, however, a conundrum for the market.

data.title: Παίζουν ρόλο τα προγράμματα;
data.description: Τα προγράμματα παραμένουν πολιτικά χρήσιμα. Διότι έστω και στην εκδοχή αυτή, δίνουν την αίσθηση ενός πολιτικού σχεδίου που ενισχύει την κυβερνησιμότητα ενός κόμματος.
data.translatedTitle: Do programs play a role?
data.translatedDescription: The programs remain politically useful. Because even in this version, they give the impression of a political plan that strengthens the governability of a party.

data.title: Κυψέλη: «Άλλο κακός πατέρας ή μητέρα και άλλο δολοφόνος»
data.description: Τη διαρροή των αποτελεσμάτων DNA από δημόσιο νοσοκομείο κατήγγειλε ο συνήγορος των γονιών του νεκρού βρέφους στην Κυψέλη, ζητώντας την απόδοση ευθυνών για τη δημοσιοποίηση προσωπικών δεδομένων.
data.translatedTitle: Hive: "Another bad father or mother and another murderer"
data.translatedDescription: The leak of the DNA results from a public hospital was denounced by the lawyer of the parents of the dead infant in Kypseli, demanding accountability for the disclosure of personal data.

data.title: Θεσσαλονίκη: Σουτζουκάκια, γύρος και… οικονομία στο δείπνο Πιερρακάκη
data.description: O Κυριάκος Πιερρακάκης παρέθεσε δείπνο στη Θεσσαλονίκη, μία μέρα πριν από την ομιλία Μητσοτάκη, συγκεντρώνοντας περισσότερους από 40 βουλευτές της Νέας Δημοκρατίας, στην πλειονότητά τους από τη Βόρεια Ελλάδα.
data.translatedTitle: Thessaloniki: Soutzoukaki, gyros and... economy at the Pierrakaki dinner
data.translatedDescription: Kyriakos Pierrakakis hosted a dinner in Thessaloniki, one day before Mitsotakis' speech, bringing together more than 40 New Democracy MPs, most of them from Northern Greece.

data.title: 5 το πρωί ΔΕΘ Edition: Τα 2 δισ. της τελευταίας ΔΕΘ πριν τις κάλπες
data.description: Ο Κυριάκος Μητσοτάκης στη Θεσσαλονίκη για την τελευταία ΔΕΘ πριν από τις κάλπες, με πακέτο άνω των 2 δισ. ευρώ και παροχές σχεδόν για όλους. Η ΝΔ παραμένει πρώτη, αλλά η αυτοδυναμία απέχει, με το Μαξίμου να ποντάρει σε καλύτερο δημοσκοπικό ταμείο. data.title: EU official says it’s not time to ‘normalize’ Russia at G20 finance talks
data.description:
ASHEVILLE: EU economy chief Valdis Dombrovskis said Tuesday that it is not the time to “normalize” Moscow’s presence at G20 meetings as European leaders pushed back against the Russian finance minister’s attendance at ongoing talks.
	“I think the European position is known,” Dombrovskis told reporters on the sidelines of the US-hosted finance leaders’ gathering in Asheville, North Carolina.
	“We do not think now is the time to normalize Russia” or its presence at such talks, the Latvian official said.

data.title: World leaders need to see rising oceans in Pacific: UN official
data.description:
KOROR: Leaders from the world's top economies should stand on a Pacific atoll to see the reality of record sea level rise, a top UN official said in Palau on Monday.

	Noting last week's deadly floods in Nepal, United Nations Deputy Secretary-General Amina Mohammed said rising seas in the Pacific were the "other side of that story".

	"We do already know that a warming climate is changing the world's ice at extraordinary speeds, not only threatening the communities below glaciers but adding more water to our oceans," she told reporters.

data.title: Samedi, Intwari va trembler
data.description:
L’horizon n’est plus une promesse.  
Il est là.
Ce samedi. 15h. Sous la voûte d’Intwari.
 Deux destins vont se heurter.  
Ici, Aigle Noir. Le patron du moment. Le club qui domine la Primus Ligue Burundi avec un doublé retentissant : 2024-2025 et 2025-2026. Le roi d’aujourd’hui.  
 Là, Al Hilal. Venu des sables du Soudan. L’ancien fief de Girumugisha Jean-Claude. Un géant taillé pour les nuits africaines.
data.translatedTitle: Saturday, Intwari will tremble

data.title: Les universitaires d’Afrique centrale lancent un réseau stratégique à Yaoundé pour lutter contre le crime organisé
data.description: © DR Des professeurs et chercheurs représentant onze unités de recherche stratégique issues d'universités du Cameroun, du Gabon, du Tchad et de la République démocratique du Congo se sont réunis à l'hôtel Star Land de Yaoundé le 4 septembre 2026 pour la réunion inaugurale d'un nouveau réseau régional de recherche. Ce rassemblement de deux jours visait à établir une alliance collaborative entre les institutions académiques des quatre nations afin de renforcer leur capacité collective à analyser, signaler et mener des actions de plaidoyer contre le crime organisé et la violence armée en Afrique centrale. Au cœur de cette initiative se trouve le projet d'Observatoire de l'Afrique centrale sur le crime organisé et la violence, lancé en 2024 par l'Initiative mondiale contre la criminalité transnationale organisée (GI-TOC) en partenariat avec l'Institut d'études de sécurité (ISS). S'étendant jusqu'en 2027, ce projet vise à créer un observatoire régional de la société civile axé sur l'analyse du lien entre criminalité et conflits, la cartographie des écosystèmes criminels et le renforcement des capacités de plaidoyer à travers l'Afrique centrale. Ses objectifs plus larges s'articulent autour de la production de données fiables, du renforcement de la recherche au sein de la société civile et de l'incitation des autorités judiciaires et politiques régionales à adopter des réponses fondées sur des preuves. Le directeur de l'Observatoire, le professeur Saïbou Issa, a souligné que cette initiative permet de faire le pont entre la recherche académique et l'action publique. Il a noté que bien que les universités disposent d'une expertise scientifique approfondie sur des enjeux complexes tels que la criminalité financière, les enlèvements avec demande de rançon, la traite des êtres humains et la cybercriminalité, ces menaces forment un écosystème criminel interconnecté. Il a précisé qu'à l'issue de la conférence, le réseau donnera la priorité à des formations spécialisées pour aider les chercheurs à transformer leurs travaux théoriques en outils décisionnels exploitables par les décideurs politiques pour lutter efficacement contre la criminalité transfrontalière. Axant son propos sur la nécessité d'une coopération régionale, le professeur René Joly Assako Assako, doyen de la Faculté des Arts, Lettres et Sciences Humaines de l'Université de Douala et représentant du Centre d'Études et de Recherche en Géoéconomie, Géopolitique et Géostratégie des Espaces Littoraux et Maritimes (3GELM), a exprimé l'espoir que ce réseau transforme la réponse sécuritaire de l'Afrique centrale. Il a insisté sur le fait que l'expertise locale ne manque pas au sein des universités et des chercheurs de la région ; le maillon manquant réside plutôt dans la coordination, le partage des ressources et la mutualisation des compétences nécessaires pour répondre aux menaces globales par des mesures unifiées. D'autres universitaires de la région ont également réitéré l'urgence d'une approche coordonnée et transfrontalière pour démanteler les réseaux criminels. La professeure Régine Nambuwa de l'Université de Kinshasa, représentant le Centre de criminologie et de pathologie sociale, a souligné que les actions isolées sont insuffisantes face à des problèmes comme le trafic illégal de minerais quittant la RDC via des pays voisins comme le Cameroun. De même, le professeur Serge Loungou de l'Université Omar Bongo au Gabon a souligné que cette initiative permet de sortir du « désengagement géopolitique », offrant aux chercheurs l'opportunité d'analyser conjointement des crimes transfrontaliers tels que le trafic d'enfants et le braconnage dans les parcs nationaux partagés. Pour la seconde journée de cette réunion inaugurale, le samedi 5 septembre 2026, les participants se concentreront sur la fixation des bases juridiques et opérationnelles du réseau. L'ordre du jour prévoit l'examen du protocole d'accord (MoU), l'identification des thématiques de recherche collaborative prioritaires et la constitution de groupes thématiques spécialisés. De plus, les délégués élaboreront un plan de travail initial couvrant les 12 à 24 prochains mois, effectueront des restitutions de travaux, établiront formellement le réseau et adopteront une feuille de route consolidée avant la clôture officielle de l'événement. À la suite de cette rencontre de deux jours, les centres de recherche stratégique se concerteront avec leurs universités respectives pour mettre en œuvre le plan de travail convenu. La première étape prioritaire portera sur le déploiement de programmes de formation méthodologique et de rédaction de rapports pour les membres du réseau, posant ainsi les jalons d'une prospective stratégique, d'une recherche collaborative durable et d'un plaidoyer politique fondé sur des données probantes en Afrique centrale. Cet article Les universitaires d’Afrique centrale lancent un réseau stratégique à Yaoundé pour lutter contre le crime organisé est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com .
data.translatedTitle: Les universitaires d’Afrique centrale lancent un réseau stratégique à Yaoundé pour lutter contre le crime organisé
data.translatedDescription: © DR Professors and researchers representing eleven strategic research units from universities in Cameroon, Gabon, Chad and the Democratic Republic of Congo gathered at the Star Land hotel in Yaoundé on September 4, 2026 for the inaugural meeting of a new regional research network. This two-day gathering aimed to establish a collaborative alliance between academic institutions from the four nations to strengthen their collective capacity to analyze, report and lead advocacy actions against organized crime and armed violence in Central Africa. At the heart of this initiative is the Central Africa Observatory on Organized Crime and Violence project, launched in 2024 by the Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime (GI-TOC) in partnership with the Institute for Security Studies (ISS). Running until 2027, this project aims to create a regional civil society observatory focused on analyzing the link between crime and conflict, mapping criminal ecosystems and strengthening advocacy capacities across Central Africa. Its broader goals revolve around producing reliable data, strengthening research within civil society, and incentivizing regional judicial and political authorities to adopt evidence-based responses. The director of the Observatory, Professor Saïbou Issa, stressed that this initiative makes it possible to bridge the gap between academic research and public action. He noted that although universities have deep scientific expertise on complex issues such as financial crime, kidnapping for ransom, human trafficking and cybercrime, these threats form an interconnected criminal ecosystem. He specified that at the end of the conference, the network will give priority to specialized training to help researchers transform their theoretical work into decision-making tools that can be used by political decision-makers to effectively combat cross-border crime. Focusing his remarks on the need for regional cooperation, Professor René Joly Assako Assako, dean of the Faculty of Arts, Letters and Human Sciences at the University of Douala and representative of the Center for Studies and Research in Geoeconomics, Geopolitics and Geostrategy of Littoral and Maritime Spaces (3GELM), expressed the hope that this network will transform the security response of Central Africa. He insisted that there is no shortage of local expertise among universities and researchers in the region; the missing link rather lies in the coordination, sharing of resources and pooling of skills necessary to respond to global threats with unified measures. Other academics in the region have also reiterated the urgency of a coordinated, cross-border approach to dismantling criminal networks. Professor Régine Nambuwa of the University of Kinshasa, representing the Center for Criminology and Social Pathology, stressed that isolated actions are insufficient in the face of problems such as the illegal trafficking of minerals leaving the DRC via neighboring countries such as Cameroon. Likewise, Professor Serge Loungou of Omar Bongo University in Gabon highlighted that this initiative allows a move away from “geopolitical disengagement”, offering researchers the opportunity to jointly analyze cross-border crimes such as child trafficking and poaching in shared national parks. For the second day of this inaugural meeting, Saturday September 5, 2026, participants will focus on establishing the legal and operational foundations of the network. The agenda provides for the review of the memorandum of understanding (MoU), the identification of priority collaborative research themes and the establishment of specialized thematic groups. Additionally, delegates will develop an initial work plan covering the next 12 to 24 months, provide work feedback, formally establish the network and adopt a consolidated roadmap before the official close of the event. Following this two-day meeting, the strategic research centers will consult with their respective universities to implement the agreed work plan. The first priority step will focus on the deployment of methodological training and report writing programs for network members, thus laying the foundations for strategic foresight, sustainable collaborative research and evidence-based policy advocacy in Central Africa. This article Central African academics launch strategic network in Yaoundé to fight organized crime appeared first on Journalducameroun.com.

data.title: Santé : l’OMS et le Fonds Mondial renforcent leur partenariat au Cameroun
data.description: © DR Le Représentant de l'OMS au Cameroun, Dr Magaran Monzon Bagayoko, a reçu ce 4 septembre 2026 le gestionnaire du Fonds Mondial Osian Jones pour renforcer leur collaboration dans la lutte contre le VIH, la tuberculose et le paludisme. Le partenariat OMS - Fonds Mondial au service de la santé. Le Représentant de l'OMS au Cameroun, Dr Magaran Monzon Bagayoko, a reçu ce 4 septembre 2026 M. Osian Jones, Gestionnaire principal du portefeuille du Fonds Mondial pour le Cameroun et la Guinée équatoriale, pour une séance de travail axée sur le renforcement de la collaboration. Au cœur des échanges : le débriefing de la mission de l'équipe pays du Fonds Mondial consacrée au Grant Making de la subvention GC8, le point sur l'accompagnement de l'OMS dans la mise en œuvre de la subvention GC7 et la préparation de la future subvention GC8. Le Fonds Mondial a salué la qualité de la collaboration et le soutien technique de l'OMS au Ministère de la Santé Publique dans la mise en œuvre des subventions. L'OMS a plaidé pour un appui accru aux activités de Renforcement du Système de Santé (RSS). Cette rencontre témoigne de la solidité du partenariat entre les deux institutions pour accélérer la lutte contre le VIH, la tuberculose et le paludisme, tout en consolidant durablement le système de santé au Cameroun. data.title: Des fonctionnaires enfarinés à l’ambassade du Cameroun en Belgique
data.description: © DR Des membres de la Brigade Anti-Sardinard ont mené une incursion au siège de la représentation diplomatique du Cameroun à Bruxelles le 03 septembre 2026. Ils ont encore fait entendre leurs revendications non sans avoir enfariné les occupants de l'ambassade. Les membres de la BAS ont fait une entrée inattendue au siège de la représentation diplomatique du Cameroun à Bruxelles le 03 septembre dernier, versant de la farine sur des fonctionnaires trouvés sur place. Exprimant leurs revendications, ils ont appelé à la libération des « prisonniers politiques » et autres détenus du genre au Cameroun. Dans la vidéo en circulation servant d'indice de leur passage, ils demandent en particulier la libération de l'activiste Jacques Bertrand Mang. Ils exigent que justice soit rendue pour des cas de détenus décédés en détention. Comme à leur habitude, ils demandent aussi le départ du président Paul Biya à la tête de l'Etat, réitérant leur prétention exprimée lors du dernier séjour du chef de l'État en Suisse. Au cours d'une autre incursion, à cette période, ils ont demandé où le président de la République se trouvait et que les autorités fournissent des explications sur son séjour à l’étranger. Ils ne sont pas à leur premier acte. L'on se souvient aussi que le ministre de la Jeunesse et de l'Education civique, Mounouna Foutsou, a subi en 2025 le même sort que les fonctionnaires de l'Ambassade ont subi jeudi. Peu avant la présidentielle, le membre du gouvernement conduisant une délégation camerounaise pour rencontrer la diaspora a été enfariné, sa suite avec, par les membres de la BAS. Cet article Des fonctionnaires enfarinés à l’ambassade du Cameroun en Belgique est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com .

data.title: Climat : l’ONACC renforce les capacités de la SODECOTON dans le Nord
data.description: © DR Du 1er au 8 septembre 2026, l'ONACC forme le personnel de la SODECOTON dans l'Extrême-Nord et le Nord sur l'utilisation des services climatologiques, pour une agriculture plus résiliente face aux changements climatiques. L'ONACC renforce les capacités de la SODECOTON sur l'utilisation des services climatologiques. Du 1er au 8 septembre 2026, l'Observatoire National sur les Changements Climatiques organise une série d'ateliers au profit du personnel de la SODECOTON dans les régions de l'Extrême-Nord (Maroua 1 & 2, Kaélé, Tchatibali et Guider) et du Nord (Garoua 1 & 2, Ngong, Touboro et Mayo-Galké). Les cérémonies officielles de lancement se sont déroulées simultanément à Maroua et Garoua le 1er septembre 2026. Le Directeur Général de l'ONACC, Pr Joseph Armathé Amougou, présidait celle de Garoua, tandis que le Directeur Général Adjoint, Forghab Patrick Mbomba, présidait celle de Maroua. L'objectif est de renforcer les compétences des participants dans l'exploitation des bulletins décadaires, saisonniers et des calendriers agricoles spécifiques produits par l'ONACC, afin d'améliorer l'appui-conseil aux producteurs et la prise de décision agricole. Cette activité s'inscrit dans le cadre du partenariat signé entre l'ONACC et la SODECOTON en 2025, et contribue au renforcement du suivi agroclimatique et à la promotion d'une agriculture plus résiliente. data.title: Genre et Budget : 50 milliards FCFA pour accélérer l’égalité
data.description: © DR Le 3 septembre 2026 à Yaoundé, le Comité interministériel BSG s'est réuni sous la présidence du SG du MINFI Gilbert Didier Edoa. Chiffres clés : 50 milliards FCFA pour le Fonds femmes et jeunes en 2026, 2010 année de lancement de la BSG, 10 administrations pilotes. Le Comité interministériel chargé du suivi de la Budgétisation Sensible au Genre passe à la vitesse supérieure. Le jeudi 03 septembre 2026, Yaoundé a accueilli l'atelier de renforcement des capacités de ses membres. Présidée par le Secrétaire Général du MINFI, Gilbert Didier Edoa, la rencontre vise à faire du budget de l'État un véritable levier d'égalité. Après plusieurs avancées dans l'intégration du genre dans les outils de programmation, l'enjeu est d'accélérer la mise en œuvre. Quelques chiffres clés illustrent l'ambition : 50 milliards FCFA, montant du Fonds spécial créé dans la Loi de Finances 2026 pour l'autonomisation des femmes et l'emploi des jeunes ; 2010, année d'adoption de la démarche BSG au Cameroun ; 10 administrations pilotes composent le périmètre actuel. Ce vendredi 04 septembre se tiendra la deuxième session du Comité. Elle permettra d'évaluer la feuille de route 2025, valider celle de 2026 et examiner les bases d'un futur Centre d'Excellence dédié à la BSG. Cet article Genre et Budget : 50 milliards FCFA pour accélérer l’égalité est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com .

data.title: Cameroun/ Décentralisation : REDECA franchit une nouvelle étape à Yaoundé
data.description: © DR Le jeudi 3 septembre 2026 à Yaoundé marque la signature de l'accord de rétrocession du projet REDECA. Dans le cadre du 3e C2D, 827 millions de FCFA sont destinés aux Communautés Urbaines de Bafoussam, Bertoua et Garoua pour renforcer la gouvernance locale. Nouvelle étape pour la décentralisation au Cameroun. Le jeudi 3 septembre 2026 s'est tenue à Yaoundé la cérémonie de signature de l'Accord de rétrocession partielle d'activités et de crédit du projet « Renforcement de la Décentralisation au Cameroun» (REDECA). Mis en œuvre dans le cadre du 3e Contrat de Désendettement et de Développement (C2D) entre le Cameroun et la France, le projet accompagne les Communautés Urbaines de Bafoussam, Bertoua et Garoua dans le renforcement de leurs capacités et l'amélioration de leur gouvernance. Une enveloppe d'environ 827 millions de FCFA leur est destinée pour renforcer les capacités institutionnelles, soutenir la participation citoyenne et améliorer le pilotage local des activités. De la responsabilité à l'action, REDECA contribue à rapprocher la décision et l'action du niveau local, au bénéfice direct des populations. Cet article Cameroun/ Décentralisation : REDECA franchit une nouvelle étape à Yaoundé est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com .
