data.title: SUUR AVASTUS ⟩ Kas meie iseloom on geenides? Miljoni inimese DNA annab seni täpseima vastuse ja teadke: elukaaslased ei ole üldse sarnased!
data.description: Miks naudib üks inimene võõrastega vestlemist, teine aga eelistab omaette olla? Miks on mõni meist äärmiselt korralik ja kohusetundlik, teine spontaansem, kolmas aga muretseb peaaegu kõige pärast? Psühholoogid on aastakümneid teadnud, et osa neist erinevustest on pärilikud. Nüüd on rohkem kui miljoni inimese DNA aidanud näha erakordse detailsusega, mida see «pärilikkus» tegelikult tähendab – ning pilt on palju keerulisem kui mõne üksiku iseloomugeeni otsimine. See uurimus on tehtud Eesti teadlaste olulise osalusega.
data.translatedTitle: BIG DISCOVERY ⟩ Is our character in our genes? The DNA of a million people gives the most accurate answer so far, and know: life partners are not alike at all!
data.translatedDescription: Why does one person enjoy talking to strangers while another prefers to be alone? Why is it that some of us are extremely neat and conscientious, others are more spontaneous, while others worry about almost everything? Psychologists have known for decades that some of these differences are hereditary. Now, the DNA of more than a million people has helped to see in extraordinary detail what this "heredity" really means - and the picture is much more complex than looking for a few individual character genes. This research has been carried out with the significant participation of Estonian researchers.

data.title: «NÜÜD OLEN JUMALA ÜKSI!» ⟩ Eaka naise kadunud lemmik jõudis varjupaika, kuid lootus koer koju tuua võttis sünge pöörde
data.description: Ihamarus elav eakas naine pöördus Elu24 poole, sest soovib tagasi oma kaduma läinud koera nimega Kudi, kes jõudis augusti lõpus Tartu Koduta Loomade Varjupaika. Naise sõnul oli koer talle oluline seltsiline ja tema eest hoolitseti hästi. «Ma ei tea, miks selline terror on. Nüüd olen jumala üksi,» ütles ta toimetusele. Varjupaiga kirjeldus Kudi tervislikust seisundist on aga sootuks teine ning juhtumiga on pöördutud põllumajandus- ja toiduameti poole.
data.translatedTitle: "NOW I AM ALONE FOR GOD!" ⟩ An elderly woman's lost pet arrived at the shelter, but the hope of bringing the dog home took a dark turn
data.translatedDescription: An elderly woman living in Hamaru turned to Elu24 because she wants to return her lost dog named Kudi, who arrived at the Tartu Homeless Animal Shelter at the end of August. According to the woman, the dog was an important companion for her and was well taken care of. "I don't know why there is such terror. Now I'm alone,» he told the editors. However, the shelter's description of Kudi's health condition is completely different, and the case has been addressed to the Agriculture and Food Board.

data.title: ELAV LAIP ⟩ Narvalanna tunnistati ekslikult surnuks. Nüüd ei saa ta pensioni ega arsti juurde
data.description: Narva pensionär Zinaida oli naabermajas juhtunud õnnetuse tunnistajaks, kuid eksituse tõttu tunnistati surnuks hoopis tema. Naise pangateenused blokeeriti, ta jäi ravikindlustuseta ning infosüsteemi märgiti isegi tema surmakuupäev. Möödunud on juba kaks nädalat, kuid Zinaida pole siiani saanud tagasi dokumente ega ligipääsu elutähtsatele teenustele.
data.translatedTitle: LIVING CORPSE ⟩ Narval woman mistakenly declared dead. Now he can't get a pension or see a doctor
data.translatedDescription: Zinaida, a pensioner from Narva, witnessed the accident in the neighboring house, but due to a mistake, she was declared dead instead. The woman's banking services were blocked, she was left without health insurance, and even the date of her death was recorded in the information system. Two weeks have already passed, but Zinaida still has not received back her documents or access to vital services.

data.title: Õigusriigi vahefiniš: Laaneti sõnul peab süütute inimeste kohtu ette tirimine lõppema
data.description: Üürihüvitisega seotud süüasjas hiljuti lõplikult õigeks mõistetud endine justiitsminister Kalle Laanet ei kavatse peatuda, nimetab toimunut kõlavalt õigusriigi vahefinišiks, ning on seadnud eesmärgiks teha kõik endast oleneva, et edaspidi süütud inimesed prokuratuuri hambusse ei satuks. Ka Laanetit kaitsnud tippadvokaat Oliver Nääs leiab, et praegune kriminaalmenetluse kord vajab reformi, et vähendada prokuratuuri pea piiramatuna näivat ainuvoli süüasjade menetlemisel ja kohtusse saatmisel.
data.translatedTitle: Intermediate finish of the rule of law: According to Laanet, dragging innocent people to court must stop
data.translatedDescription: Former Minister of Justice Kalle Laanet, who was recently finally acquitted in the case related to rent compensation, does not intend to stop, he calls what happened sonically the intermediate finish of the rule of law, and has set himself the goal of doing everything possible to prevent innocent people from falling into the teeth of the prosecutor's office in the future. The top lawyer who defended Laanet, Oliver Nääs, also believes that the current criminal procedure needs reform in order to reduce the almost unlimited discretion of the prosecutor's office in handling cases and sending them to court.

data.title: Uus oht õhust: Venemaa võttis Kiievi vastu kasutusele Geran-5 raketid
data.description: Venemaa ründas Kiievit kahel järjestikusel päeval uute Geran-5 reaktiivrakettidega, mis viitab relva saamisele osaks nende alalisest rünnakuarsenalist. Kuigi Ukraina õhutõrje tõrjus umbes 400 km kauguselt tulistatud raketid, hoiatavad eksperdid püsiva ohu ja püüdurrakettide madala tõhususe eest selle süsteemi vastu.
data.translatedTitle: A new threat from the air: Russia deployed Geran-5 missiles against Kiev
data.translatedDescription: Russia attacked Kiev on two consecutive days with new Geran-5 rockets, indicating that the weapon is becoming part of their permanent offensive arsenal. Although Ukrainian air defenses repulsed the missiles fired from a distance of about 400 km, experts warn of a persistent threat and the low effectiveness of interceptor missiles against this system.

data.title: Arendt on teejuht ka tühistamise ja unustamise ajastul
data.description: Elame ajastul, kus Facebooki seinad on täis viha ja poliitilised kemplemised ning nn kultuurisõjad jagavad maailma mustvalgeks. Et selles müras mitte kaotada oma inimlikkust ja mõtlemisvõimet, peaks Eesti poliitiku ja valija lektüüriks olema Hannah Arendti «Totalitarismi lätted».
data.translatedTitle: Arendt is also a guide in the age of cancellation and forgetting
data.translatedDescription: We live in an age where Facebook walls are filled with anger and political bickering, and so-called culture wars divide the world into black and white. In order not to lose one's humanity and ability to think in this noise, the Estonian politician and voter should read Hannah Arendt's "Flats of Totalitarianism".

data.title: GALERII ⟩ Kosmose kinos toimus «Morteni» erilinastus filmi tegijatega
data.description: 4. septembril toimus Cinamon Kosmose kinos uue Eesti mängufilm «Morten» erilinastus koos kõigi filmi tegijatega. Film põhineb kirjanik Reeli Reinausi auhinnatud raamatul «Morten, Emilie ja kadunud maailmad». Nimiosas astub üles Tõru Kannimäe (»Fränk»). Kaasa teevad ka Külli Teetamm, Andres Mähar, Priit Loog jt. «Morteni» stsenarist on Reeli Reinaus ja režissöör Ivan Pavljutškov. Ametlikult jõuab film kinodesse 11. septembril.
data.translatedTitle: GALLERY ⟩ A special screening of "Morten" was held in the Kosmos cinema with the makers of the film
data.translatedDescription: On September 4, a special screening of the new Estonian feature film "Morten" was held in Cinamon Kosmos cinema with all the filmmakers. The film is based on the award-winning book "Morten, Emilie and the Lost Worlds" by writer Reeli Reinaus. Tõru Kannimäe ("Fränk") will play the title role. Other important roles are played by Helena Maria Reisner ("Seltsimees laps") and Emili Rohumaa. Also participating are Külli Teetamm, Andres Mähar, Priit Loog and others. "Morten" is written by Reeli Reinaus and directed by Ivan Pavlyuchkov. The film will officially hit theaters on September 11.

data.description: Madride pirmomis rugsėjo dienomis kilę protestai sulaukė ir Lietuvos internautų dėmesio. Tiesa, jie vaizdus iš didžiulių mitingų interpretuoja ne visai teisingai. data.title: JAV pasiuntiniai vyksta į Maskvą ir Kyjivą: ar vizito metu bus paskelbtos paliaubos?
data.description: „Ukrainska Pravda“ skelbia, kad Ukrainos gynybos pajėgoms nurodyta rugsėjo 5–8 dienomis laikytis paliaubų režimo. Tačiau dėl susitarimo kyla neaiškumų – Ukrainos kariuomenės ir Prezidento biuro šaltiniai teigia, kad įsakymo nutraukti kovos veiksmus visame fronte nebuvo. Tuo metu Rusija praėjusią naktį ir toliau atakavo Ukrainą. Šeštadienį į Maskvą, o vėliau į Kyjivą vyksta JAV prezidento Donaldo Trumpo pasiuntiniai Steve'as Witkoffas ir Jaredas Kushneris, siekiantys atnaujinti derybas dėl karo pabaigos. Iki šiol Maskva nesilaikė nė vieno susitarimo dėl paliaubų. Ar šį kartą bus kitaip?
data.translatedTitle: US envoys go to Moscow and Kyiv: will a truce be announced during the visit?
data.translatedDescription: "Ukrainska Pravda" reports that the Ukrainian Defense Forces have been instructed to observe a ceasefire from September 5-8. However, there is uncertainty about the agreement - sources from the Ukrainian military and the President's office say that there was no order to cease hostilities on the entire front. Meanwhile, Russia continued to attack Ukraine last night. On Saturday, US President Donald Trump's envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are heading to Moscow and then to Kyiv to resume talks on ending the war. So far, Moscow has not adhered to any ceasefire agreement. Will this time be different?

data.title: Netopia Payments expands license to include money remittance services after Romania’s Central Bank approval
data.description: Romanian payments and technology platform Netopia Payments is entering a new stage of development after it received the authorization of the National Bank of Romania (BNR) to expand its payment institution license to include money remittance services, the company said. The company, which processes more than RON 10 billion annually, is preparing new embedded finance solutions and developing an integrated financial platform for merchants, it said. The company aims to expand its portfolio of services for merchants beyond traditional online payment processing and toward a comprehensive financial ecosystem. At the same time, it is preparing to diversify the payment methods it accepts, including through the integration of account-to-account (A2A) solutions such as RoPay, and to expand financing options offered through partners, including merchant cash advance products. Netopia’s priorities for the coming period include operationalizing its newly licensed activities, developing new financial products, and expanding its technology and operational infrastructure. “Obtaining the license from the National Bank of Romania validates our security and compliance standards, but more importantly, it provides the foundation on which we are building Netopia’s future. Our vision is to become a comprehensive growth partner for entrepreneurs in Romania,” Raluca Micu , CEO of Netopia, said. In the medium term, the company aims to build a one-stop shop model for merchants, a unified platform integrating multiple payment methods, rapid funds collection, automated transaction reconciliation, and complementary financial services. Netopia Payments is a Romanian payments and technology platform for merchants, providing digital payment infrastructure and financial solutions to thousands of companies. Since 2023, private equity fund Innova Capital holds a majority stake in the company. (Photo: the company) simona@romania-insider.com

data.title: Romanian construction company Concelex appoints Daniel Spiridon, Carol Șerban to strategy and transformation roles
data.description: Romanian construction company Concelex announced it was strengthening its management team by bringing in two professionals with international backgrounds in strategy and transformation. Daniel Spiridon , with over 20 years’ experience in management consulting and executive leadership, has joined Concelex as Deputy CEO Strategy. Carol Șerban , a construction engineering graduate with international experience in strategic consulting, has joined as Director of Strategy and Transformation . The two appointments “support Concelex's current phase of accelerated growth and strengthen the company's capabilities in strategy, organizational transformation, and business development,” the company said. Daniel Spiridon ( in opening photo ) spent more than 15 years at McKinsey & Company, where he rose through every stage of his career to become Managing Partner of the local office. He subsequently joined eMAG as VP Business Development and Strategy and, as CEO, led eMAG's operations in Hungary. A graduate in economics, he also holds a Master's degree in International Business and Finance from BI Norwegian Business School. As Deputy CEO Strategy, he will oversee the implementation of Concelex's strategy, develop the Strategy and Transformation function, and be involved in developing and optimizing the company's business portfolio, with the goal of strengthening its competitiveness and profitability. Carol Șerban Carol Șerban brings a construction engineering educational background paired with experience in international strategic consulting. A graduate of the Technical University of Civil Engineering Bucharest, he holds a Master's degree in Structural Engineering from the University of Manchester and an MBA from the University of Oxford. He began his career in the UK, where he spent seven years in civil and structural engineering and project management, before joining Kearney's Romania office. He has also held the position of Commercial Director at Glovo Romania. As Director of Strategy and Transformation at Concelex, he will coordinate organizational transformation programs, with a focus on optimizing business processes, accelerating digitalization, and identifying strategic initiatives to support the company's performance. “Concelex has reached a stage where the scale of the projects we manage and the company’s accelerated growth prospects require us to continuously strengthen our leadership team. Daniel and Carol bring complementary experience and a valuable perspective on how we build, organize, and prepare for the next stage of growth. They are professionals with a solid track record in their fields, and I am confident they will make a significant contribution to Concelex's development in the coming years," Radu Pițurlea, chairman and CEO, Concelex, said. (Photos: the company) simona@romania-insider.com

data.title: Central Romania: Restored castle in Covasna reopens to the public
data.description: The Miko Castle in the village of Olteni, Covasna County, which has been restored with EU funding, is set to reopen its doors on Saturday, September 5, Agerpres reported. Built in 1827 by Count Miko Miklos, the castle is notable for the murals discovered on its interior walls during the restoration work. The paintings depict scenes from the social life of the period, as well as scenes from the Napoleonic Wars. The property was returned to the descendants of Count Miko in 2007. Seven years later, they sold it to the Covasna County Council and the Bodoc Local Council. The restoration was carried out as part of a project worth approximately RON 20 million, co-financed by EU funds through the National Recovery and Resilience Plan (PNRR). The castle will house the Székely Equestrian Museum, a section of the Székely National Museum in Sfântu Gheorghe. The castle is also set to become part of the Transylvanian Manor Houses Route, one of 12 national cultural tourism routes financed through PNRR, the Covasna County Council said . The reopening will also be marked by a screening of the Italian film Vita mia , directed by Edoardo Winspeare, which features several scenes filmed inside the castle. Other events for the opening weekend include a tour focusing on the history of the castle, and a guided tour of the Székely Equestrian Museum. (Photo: Consiliul Județean Covasna) simona@romania-insider.com

data.title: Swedish man wanted over Stockholm shooting apprehended in Romania
data.description: Romanian organized crime prosecutors have apprehended a Swedish citizen wanted by authorities in his home country over his alleged involvement in a shooting targeting two people in Stockholm. The suspect had lived in Romania for approximately three years, according to the Directorate for Investigating Organized Crime and Terrorism (DIICOT), as reported by Biziday.ro . Prosecutors searched two properties in Bucharest and nearby Otopeni as part of an investigation into organized crime and aggravated murder. According to investigators, several individuals tried to kill two people at a Stockholm address in September 2024. One of them allegedly fired at the building, with bullets passing through the entrance door and entering the home. DIICOT said the suspect helped those involved in the attack, with his actions considered serious illegal threats aggravated by the use of a firearm. Swedish authorities issued an arrest warrant for the man. He will be brought before a judge at the Bucharest Court of Appeal, with Romanian and Swedish law enforcement agencies cooperating in the case through Eurojust. During the searches, authorities seized an air gun, a gas pistol, a bulletproof vest, quantities of plant material, data-storage devices, and bladed weapons. According to DIICOT, another Swedish citizen suspected of belonging to a rival organized crime group was located in Romania in late July. A Romanian court ordered his detention pending extradition in connection with an alleged conspiracy to commit murder. irina.marica@romania-insider.com (Photo source: Inquam Photos/ George Călin )

data.title: Estée Lauder Romania renews SkyTower lease, moves to new office
data.description: Estée Lauder Romania has extended its lease at Bucharest’s SkyTower for a third time and relocated its headquarters to a newly fitted-out space on the building’s ninth floor. The beauty company has operated from the office tower since 2017. The announcement did not disclose the duration or financial terms of the renewed lease, nor the size of the new office. “This extension reflects our commitment to our team and our activities in Romania,” said Adrian Simionescu, country manager of Estée Lauder Romania. The company also uses SkyTower’s SkyHub and board meeting areas to organize events. Located in northern Bucharest, SkyTower is owned by Raiffeisen Property Holding International. The 137-meter building has 37 floors and is Romania’s tallest office tower. Its underground structure extends to a depth of 60 meters and provides parking and storage space. irina.marica@romania-insider.com (Photo source: press release)

data.title: Romanian tech group Arobs sells Polish subsidiary to WB Electronics
data.description: Arobs Transilvania Software, one of the largest technology companies listed on the Bucharest Stock Exchange, has sold its entire stake in Arobs Polska to WB Electronics. Before the sale, the company acquired the 5.66% stake held by Michal Drogosz, enabling the subsequent transfer to WB Electronics of 100% of the share capital of Arobs Polska, the company said in a filing with the Bucharest Stock Exchange. The filing did not disclose the value of the transaction. The decision to sell comes as the company pursues a focus on “areas where the group has established capabilities, can leverage international synergies and sees the most relevant growth opportunities.” These areas include software and engineering services for the automotive industry, IoT and telematics, enterprise software, life sciences and travel. Arobs Polska focuses on developing electronic solutions for satellite applications, giving it a distinct profile compared with the group’s core business lines. Its activity is characterized by extended development cycles, projects carried out predominantly under institutional programs, and specific capital and infrastructure requirements, Arobs explained. The integration of Arobs Polska into WB Electronics will ensure the continuity of ongoing projects and provide the team with access to an industrial platform and a portfolio of programs suited to the specific nature of its activities, the company said. The transaction does not affect the current operations of Arobs Transilvania Software. (Photo: Arobs Facebook Page) simona@romania-insider.com

data.title: Romanian court lifts house arrest for mercenary Horațiu Potra in alleged coup plot case
data.description: Romania’s High Court of Cassation and Justice lifted the house arrest imposed on mercenary Horațiu Potra on Thursday, September 3, allowing him to remain free under judicial supervision while standing trial. The court granted Potra’s appeal against the previous preventive measure, Agerpres reported. Horațiu Potra is one of the main defendants in a case concerning an alleged plot to destabilize Romania following the annulment of the 2024 presidential election . The High Court released him from pre-trial detention in mid-June and placed him under house arrest, ordering him to wear an electronic monitoring bracelet. He had been in custody since November 2025 , when he was brought back to Romania from Dubai together with his son and nephew. Prosecutors indicted Potra on charges including attempted actions against the constitutional order, illegal possession of weapons and ammunition, violations of rules governing explosives and pyrotechnic materials, and public incitement. He is being tried alongside 20 alleged members of his mercenary group and former presidential candidate Călin Georgescu . Prosecutors claim Horațiu Potra and his associates planned to infiltrate protests held after the December 2024 election annulment to provoke unrest and violent confrontations. According to investigators, Cãlin Georgescu and his associates devised the plan during a meeting at a farm in Ciolpani shortly after the election was annulled. Potra allegedly coordinated efforts to bring a group of mercenaries to Bucharest and escalate the demonstrations into actions capable of destabilizing the constitutional order. The allegations remain subject to examination by the court, and the defendants are presumed innocent until a final ruling. irina.marica@romania-insider.com (Photo source: Inquam Photos/Octav Ganea)
data.translatedTitle: Romanian court lifts house arrest for mercenary Horațiu Potra in alleged coup plot case
data.translatedDescription: Romania’s High Court of Cassation and Justice lifted the house arrest imposed on mercenary Horațiu Potra on Thursday, September 3, allowing him to remain free under judicial supervision while standing trial. The court granted Potra’s appeal against the previous preventive measure, Agerpres reported. Horațiu Potra is one of the main defendants in a case concerning an alleged plot to destabilize Romania following the annulment of the 2024 presidential election . The High Court released him from pre-trial detention in mid-June and placed him under house arrest, ordering him to wear an electronic monitoring bracelet. He had been in custody since November 2025 , when he was brought back to Romania from Dubai together with his son and nephew. Prosecutors indicted Potra on charges including attempted actions against the constitutional order, illegal possession of weapons and ammunition, violations of rules governing explosives and pyrotechnic materials, and public incitement. He is being tried alongside 20 alleged members of his mercenary group and former presidential candidate Călin Georgescu . Prosecutors claim Horațiu Potra and his associates planned to infiltrate protests held after the December 2024 election annulment to provoke unrest and violent confrontations. According to investigators, Cãlin Georgescu and his associates devised the plan during a meeting at a farm in Ciolpani shortly after the election was annulled. Potra allegedly coordinated efforts to bring a group of mercenaries to Bucharest and escalate the demonstrations into actions capable of destabilizing the constitutional order. The allegations remain subject to examination by the court, and the defendants are presumed innocent until a final ruling. irina.marica@romania-insider.com (Photo source: Inquam Photos/Octav Ganea)

data.title: Ukrainian Refugees Leave Poland Amid Rising Tensions
data.description: Ukrainian refugees are increasingly leaving Poland for other European nations, primarily Germany and the Czech Republic, according to updated Eurostat data. data.title: DSP o Maquiavélico Ganancioso
data.description: Guineenses, mais uma vez, venho para vos alertar sobre o perigo que Domingos Simões Pereira representa para a Guiné-Bissau. Faço esse alerta a todos os guineenses sem exceção que se encontre no país ou no estrangeiro, ao PAIGC em especial e na pessoa do Cipriano Cassamá em concreto. Alerta esse sobre o verdadeiro DSP, o verdadeiro espírito que move esse sujeito, o qual alguns ainda continuam a acreditar para não dizer adorar. Domingos Simões Pereira é um manipulador, um verdadeiro chantagista e calculista provavelmente, tipo de comportamento que ultrapassa o nível de psicopata. U m ambicioso desmedido, um verdadeiro criminoso que sabe como e quando cometer o crime. Ele jamais coabitaria não só com JOMAV, assim como com qualquer presidente que seria eleito, a não ser o que ele apoiou disfarçadamente. Isto porque ele tem sua própria agenda, e o PAIGC é simplesmente uma plataforma para sua concretização. DSP jamais coabitaria com JOMAV porque o seu candidato preferido era o Paulo Gomes e sempre será, o qual juntamente com Tchitchi vão delineando mecanismo de modo a serem os novos donos da Guiné-Bissau. Segundo eles este é um processo a médio prazo, e é preciso coragem e paciência para concretiza-lo. Ganhar o congresso não importa em que circunstância e ter novamente o partido na mão, é uma fase concluída em proveito deles, enquanto verdadeiros militantes do PAIGC estão a bater palmas. Depois dessa eleição legislativa, não importa o resultado, o Cipriano Cassama que se prepare a mala ou fica de bico fechado, pois o candidato preferido para o partido será o Paulo Gomes, e esse sim deve ter a voz dentro do partido. DSP é um ambicioso desmedido, nunca teve consideração por ninguém, JOMAV muito menos, o sujeito é um maquiavélico nato, Cipriano Casama será descartado quando menos esperar podes tomar a nota. Guineenses, falar do Paulo Gomes e Tchitchi é falar do MCCI e demais outras organizações e personalidades camufladas no nosso país. Esses dois indivíduos são os principais financiadores do MCCI e demais outras personalidades boca de aluguel na cidade de Bissau. O MCCI, Milícia idealizado por JBV e DSP, agora financiado e dirigido por "futuro triângulo do poder" ou seja, "DSP, Paulo Gomes e Tchitchi", têm 3 principais objectivos: 1º Perturbar a ordem pública em nome da cidadania, difamar e tentar descredibilizar qualquer que seja organizações ou indivíduos não alinhados ao triângulo, de modo a suportar suas caminhadas na busca do poder. 2º Caso se concretize o objectivo do triângulo, o papel da Milícia do MCCI passará a ser de vigilância constante a todos os adversários de modo a garantir falsa paz social e o poder de controlo. 3º Tentar ganhar credibilidade junto das organizações internacionais e regionais, através de suas visitas e actividades de fachada, para quando houver as tais actividades de perturbações de ordem pública, poderem ganhar notoriedade. Mas isso não deve preocupar ninguém, pois estão bem identificados e bem caçados, dentro e fora da Guiné-Bissau. Não tenho nada contra ninguém, mas quem continuar a perturbar verdadeira paz social dos guineenses em troca de benefícios como sempre foi nos últimos anos dessa crise, e que sempre tenho tolerado, então que fique claro "estou firme e determinado para tudo e todos". Para finalizar, gostaria de vos deixar uma reflexão com a seguinte frase: " Domingos Simões Pereira é um perigo grave para o futuro do país ". Isto porque publicar aqui tudo que é necessário para provar ou sustentar a razão dessa frase, só pode agravar ainda mais a paz social que tanto necessitamos. Chega, chega não podemos continuar a viver nessa turbulência vida toda, meus irmãos guineenses, não é saudável, é tóxico, não é justo para um povo que tanto sofreu. António Aly Silva » aaly.silva@gmail.com » aaly_silva@hotmail.com » Tel. (+245) 668 31 13

data.title: DSP, UM PERIGO GRAVE PARA FUTURO DO PAÍS
data.description: Os meios de comunicação também são as formas de manipulação mais utilizadas pelos poderes políticos, dado o seu impacto social. As informações são manipuladas não apenas tendo em vista omitir factos relevantes, mas também distorcer o conteúdo da informação veiculada, produzir ou forjar a opinião pública, de modo que a mesma se ajuste às ideias dos gananciosos. A única forma dos cidadãos evitarem cair nestes processos de manipulação é tornarem-se mais vigilantes em relação às instituições democráticas e aos órgãos de informação, adoptando uma atitude de permanente reflexão crítica sobre a informação que lhes é fornecida. Na Guiné-Bissau, nos últimos anos, cresceu exponencialmente o número de pessoas mediocres, pessoas sem escrúpulos ligadas à produção de rádios e outros meios de comunicação com influencia na nossa sociedade, gente que apesar da sua enorme influência na sociedade, trabalha na mais completa impunidade e sem qualquer controlo ético/democrático. Obcecado pelo poder, ciente da dificuldade do povo guineense em avaliar informações, ciente do poder dos instrumentos de comunicação, Domingos Simões Pereira (DSP) nunca menosprezou esses instrumentos para atingir seu objectivo, sempre usou-os de forma desonesta como agora está a fazer tudo por tudo para manter no controlo desses veicúlos, mesmo que isso custe a vida dos outros. Governou na corrupção, no nepotismo e no desvios de somas astronómicas do dinheiro de povo, que muito serviria para investimentos na saúde, educação e outros serviços publicos, para beneficiar familiares e amigos. Finge que preocupa com os problemas do país, mas só engana o povo honesto, humilde e trabalhador que infelizmente sofre muito, não sei até quando, devido a sua paciência e tolerância aos governantes como DSP, criminoso travestido em politico que vive na custa de povo e acima de tudo ainda fa-lo refem do próprio suor. Roubou e decepcionou tanto não só aos guineenses assim como a comunidade internacional que sempre acreditou que o sujeito era ideal para ajudar esse povo a sair do ciclo de sofrimento que parece infinito. Foi demitido, não conformou e está a fazer tudo na medida do possível para continuar a complicar a vida dos guineenses. Razão disso é que depois de perder a batalha nos meios de comunicações mais modernos nomeadamente os blogues onde investiu grandes somas do dinheiro de povo, para fazer a lavagem cerebral dos menos instruídos e não só. Fugiu do facebook onde sempre frequentava e comunicava com todos tentado passar a mensagem de um politico moderno e aberto a diálogo/opiniões, mas que afinal era simplesmente um falso modernista. Caiu a mascara e já não consegue enganar ninguem, pois a sua credibilidade está abaixo de zero, para não dizer outra coisa. Camaradas, para conhecimento geral, com o dinheiro roubado que custou suor de povo guineense, DSP decidiu avançar com um outro novo plano maquiavelico, para criar a sua própria estação de rádio.
